races.race_name: British Stallions Studs EBF Nursery Handicap (A Hamilton Park 2-Y-O Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Call Nicki
runners.spotlight: Has run to a similar level in four starts since her debut, coming home strongly when winning a C&D maiden three weeks ago (good to firm; runner-up went close in a handicap next time); mark adjusted by 4lb since but in the thick of it now handicapping.
runners.comment: C&D winner on good to firm latest; in the thick of it now handicapping

runners.name: Tango Hotel
runners.spotlight: Has improved with each start, running creditably in a valuable seller at Musselburgh on second start, then coming clear in Ffos Las maiden (5f, soft) four weeks ago, where the stiffer test at the trip, soft ground and possibly first-time cheekpieces may all have played a part; this provides a different test but she may be up to it.
runners.comment: Improved with each start, coming clear on soft latest; different test on handicap debut

runners.name: Caturra Lights
runners.spotlight: Never involved from the widest draw at Chester in May but he'd run two good races previously, on Musselburgh debut (5f, good; 66-1) then looked the likely winner over slightly further at Chester before run down late; the stiff finish on this track should see him to good effect; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well held from bad draw latest but two good runs previously; respected on handicap debut

runners.name: Or Another
runners.spotlight: Has ability but he was difficult to keep on the straight and narrow when making his handicap debut at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last week and was eased inside the final furlong; queried now with first-time visor replaced with cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Has ability but hung quite badly on 5f handicap debut last week; headgear switch

races.race_name: Wellman Cars Hamilton Handicap

runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Enjoying a fine season and his fifth win (including over C&D) of the campaign came at Wolverhampton (7f) two days ago when completing a quick hat-trick; leading claims turned out under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Completed hat-trick at Wolverhampton two days ago; this C&D winner is the one to beat

runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Gained a second win of 2026 at Musselburgh (5f) in June; only seventh of 11 in 5f Ayr handicap three days ago so she needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Only seventh of 11 in 5f Ayr handicap three days ago so she needs to bounce back

runners.name: You Mystify Me
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in C&D novice in May but she has failed to go on sent handicapping, last of ten at Musselburgh (5f) last month;  cheekpieces are reached for now.
runners.comment: Runner-up in C&D novice in May but has failed to go on sent handicapping; cheekpieces on
runners.owner: N Bradley Racing 29 & South Bank Racing

runners.name: Fear And Fast
runners.spotlight: 0-20 and he arrives below par, just fifth of ten in 5f Musselburgh handicap last month; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-20 and he arrives below par, fifth at Musselburgh last month; others appeal more
runners.owner: Let's Be Lucky Racing 38 & Steven Wilson

runners.name: Great Profit
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage sort who posted easily his best effort for new yard with second in 5f Ayr handicap last month; needs considering off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Easily best effort for new yard with second at Ayr latest; considered off  unchanged mark

runners.name: Realistic Dream
runners.spotlight: Remains winless and she beat one over C&D five days ago; more is required if she's to gain a breakthrough win at the 12th attempt.
runners.comment: Remains winless and she beat one over C&D five days ago; more is required here

runners.name: Henery Hawk
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Wolverhampton (5f) in May and comes here on the back of a solid third of 13 in 6f Ayr handicap ten days ago; must enter calculations eased 1lb in his bid for a first turf victory.
runners.comment: Solid third at Ayr latest; enters calculations in his bid for a first turf victory

runners.name: Sixcor
runners.spotlight: Took this in 2025 but winless since and just a fair fifth of eight over C&D five days ago; this veteran needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Took this in 2025 but winless since and just a fair fifth of eight over C&D five days ago

races.race_name: Alex McWilliams Memorial Celebrations Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: My Mate Roger
runners.spotlight: Has shown fair form when runner-up on all four starts, most recently in 1m2f novice at Doncaster last month; since gelded and this son of Blue Point is the one to beat with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Runner-up all four starts, most recently at Doncaster; since gelded and is the one to beat

runners.name: Matter Of Britain
runners.spotlight: Victor Ludorum gelding; half-brother to 7f 2yo winner Brastias (RPR 72); dam 1m-1m6f maiden (RPR 66), sister to 1m4f-15.5f winner Theatro; has had wind surgery ahead of his debut but in good hands and needs considering.
runners.comment: Has had wind surgery ahead of his debut but in good hands and needs considering

runners.name: Al Fujairah
runners.spotlight: 66-1, hinted at promise with a staying-on fourth of seven in maiden here (1m1f, good to firm) on his debut three weeks ago; this son of Churchill can do better in the longer term.
runners.comment: Hinted at promise with debut fourth here; can do better in the longer term

runners.name: Shatin Beauty
runners.spotlight: 40-1 and green when a never-dangerous sixth of eight in maiden at Ayr (6f, soft) on her debut last month; needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Green when sixth of eight at Ayr on her debut last month; needs to take big step forward

runners.name: Test Run
runners.spotlight: Sent off 80-1 but shaped well when fourth of ten in Doncaster maiden (1m, soft) on his debut in September; off since but this Time Test gelding remains with potential.
runners.comment: Shaped well when debut Doncaster fourth in September; off since but still with potential

runners.name: Blairtum Night
runners.spotlight: Well held in a pair of 7f novices at Newcastle and Carlisle eight months apart; significantly more is required.
runners.comment: Well held in a pair of 7f novices at Newcastle and Carlisle eight months apart

races.race_name: Wellman Cars Private Hire Almada Mile Handicap

runners.name: I'll Be Back
runners.spotlight: Justified short odds in 6f Doncaster maiden on sole 2yo start; much better form on reappearance at Leicester (7f, good) in April, looking strong in the closing stages against rivals who have given the form a weighty look since; has to prove stamina over the new trip, and his pedigree is more about sprinting on the dam's side, but still intriguing on handicap debut if ground is thought suitable (missed recent intended run on good to firm).
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 when winning over 7f in April and that form worked out well; handicap debut

runners.name: English Oak
runners.spotlight: High-class handicap form at 6f to 1m on a range of surfaces and he was up against it when second to a progressive winner in this race last year; has since won two handicaps at Meydan for new yard and perhaps felt the lack of a recent run when mid-division in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot last month; leading player.
runners.comment: High-class handicapper; 2nd to a progressive winner here in 2025; leading player

runners.name: Salam Dubawi
runners.spotlight: Sole French win on heavy ground but he's excelled on good and quicker for new yard, having far too much power for his rivals when making all here (about 1m1f) in May and doing really well to be third (demoted to fifth) in a major York handicap (extended 1m2f) on Saturday; needs a strong pace back at this trip which he may well set himself; good claims.
runners.comment: Excelled himself in big York handicap on Saturday; should give it plenty over shorter trip

runners.name: Monarch's Gold
runners.spotlight: Two 6f AW wins as a juvenile and he nearly pulled off a step up in trip when going down narrowly at Chester (extended 7f, good) in May; had no chance of getting involved after getting badly hampered on the rail at Epsom in June; gelded since; open to some improvement but he's another trying a new trip.
runners.comment: Nearly pulled off a step up in trip when close 2nd at about 7f in May; new distance

runners.name: Rhoscolyn
runners.spotlight: A superstar down the years and he's quite well treated again now but all his handicap wins at 7f and 1m have been on downhill tracks on good to soft or slower ground; better days ahead once the rains come.
runners.comment: Favourable mark but all handicap wins on downhill tracks on good to soft and slower ground

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap

runners.name: Jannas Journey
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win of 2026 in 1m handicap at Carlisle 12 days ago, getting up late to deny Inspired having been set a lot to do; bagged a remarkable seven successes (including here) last season so merits serious consideration now she's up and running this time around.
runners.comment: Set lot to do when scoring at Carlisle latest; course winner merits serious consideration

runners.name: Sanafi Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Ex-German 1m1f winner; gained a first win for current yard over C&D in May and not discredited when third of five (Kaleido runner-up) over C&D five days ago; not out of things with relatively few miles still on the clock.
runners.comment: C&D winner; not discredited when third over C&D five days ago; not out of things

runners.name: Inspired
runners.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m) in December and has proved reliable without adding to his tally this season, a clear second of seven to Jannas Journey in 1m Carlisle handicap 12 days ago; not taken lightly despite a 2lb weights rise.
runners.comment: Clear second of seven at Carlisle 12 days ago; not taken lightly despite 2lb weights rise
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood

runners.name: Break The Bank
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m scorer for Andrew Balding in 2024; off 22 months but quickly back on track with second of ten in 1m2f handicap at Ayr 11 days ago; needs considering off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Off 22 months but back on track with second at Ayr; needs considering off unchanged mark

runners.name: Kaleido
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f winner for John and Thady Gosden last summer; has steadily found his form for current yard, runner-up in five-runner event over C&D five days ago; player off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Good second over C&D five days ago; a player off an unchanged mark

races.race_name: cubeglassladiesnight@hamiltonpark Handicap

runners.name: Tarlac
runners.spotlight: Not in the same form as he was in May and June last year but he's on a lowly mark now and, after being pushed along from some way out, he did stick well to the task when fourth over C&D (good to firm) recently; form case to be made down in grade.
runners.comment: Below best this year but down weights and creditable 4th over C&D latest; down in grade
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Rain Cap
runners.spotlight: Won this race in 2022 and finished runner-up in two of three subsequent runnings; looked to be running into form again when fourth of eight at Catterick (7f, good to firm) 24 days ago and a very good run is likely.
runners.comment: Won this in 2022 and 2nd in two subsequent runnings; very likely to go well again

runners.name: Lady Bouquet
runners.spotlight: All three turf wins at 5f, including on this course, but she has won over this trip on the AW and ran well enough over 6f at Pontefract (good) recently to expect her to be on the premises.
runners.comment: All three turf wins at 5f but has won over 6f on AW; creditable show latest; thereabouts

runners.name: Baby Rover
runners.spotlight: Had a good run of form in early summer last year, getting off the mark at Redcar (6f, good to firm), but rather up and down since and she found little at Ayr ten days ago; hard to rule out if back to best, though.
runners.comment: Good run of form early last summer; up and down since; faded at Ayr recently
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd And Partner

runners.name: Doon The Glen
runners.spotlight: Has an ordinary strike-rate overall but he broke his turf duck over C&D (good to soft; acts well on good to firm) in June and nearly always runs well in sprints on this track; one of the better options.
runners.comment: Ordinary strike-rate but has won over C&D and nearly always runs well on this track

runners.name: Bring Her Home
runners.spotlight: Minor form in a handful of starts, including at classified level and in handicaps, but this is only her third run for Jim Goldie and the return to 6f could suit on second run since wind surgery; may yet improve; cheekpieces fitted.
runners.comment: Minor form so far but having second run since wind op; could yet improve; cheekpieces on

runners.name: A Lady Forever
runners.spotlight: Winning return from a long absence in early 2025 but she's finding it hard to sustain her effort in sprints on AW and turf this year, even allowing for finishing second of eight on Newcastle AW (5f) in June; headgear left off; up against it.
runners.comment: Finding it hard to sustain effort in sprints this year; headgear left off; up against it

races.race_name: Hamilton Park Centenary Year Handicap

runners.name: Alnayef
runners.spotlight: Finally got off the mark when a wide-margin winner over C&D three weeks ago; able to dictate the pace there so more is probably needed from a 6lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Finally got off the mark over C&D; dictated there so more probably needed off 6lb higher

runners.name: Bruce Banner
runners.spotlight: A dual 1m4f AW winner (also scored over hurdles) in 2025; running with credit without winning this season until only fourth of five at Beverley (1m4f) 13 days ago; he's the sort to bounce back in a change of headgear.
runners.comment: In good form until fourth of five at Beverley; sort to bounce back in a headgear change

runners.name: Aighear
runners.spotlight: A two-time winner (at up to 1m7f) last autumn; failed to build on earlier promise when only sixth of eight in 1m5f handicap at Ayr ten days ago; this course winner needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Only sixth at Ayr ten days ago; this course winner needs to get back on track

runners.name: Time Turner
runners.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough success at Newcastle (1m4f) in January; back from five months off in good nick, though seemed unsuited by the drop back in trip when fifth of eight at Nottingham (1m2f) 12 days ago; remains unexposed over this trip so very much one to consider.
runners.comment: Seemed unsuited by drop in trip with Nottingham fifth latest; very much one to consider

runners.name: Desert Quest
runners.spotlight: Winless since January 2024 but he arrives in good nick, third in 1m5f classified event at Ayr (disqualified for riding weighing in light) last month; not out of things back in handicap company.
runners.comment: Winless since January 2024 but arrives in good nick; not out of things back in handicaps
runners.owner: A Whillans, C Spark, J Wright

races.race_name: togetheragainfestival.co.uk Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Lyrics Of Life
runners.spotlight: Threatened on occasions as a 2yo and also excelled herself when a close fifth in a Group 3 in France (1m, very soft) last October; began her 3yo campaign with two solid efforts but she was well beaten at Royal Ascot four weeks ago; hood now tried and a tongue tie returns; won't find a better chance to break her duck.
runners.comment: Struggled at Royal Ascot latest but she holds strong claims in this uncompetitive event

runners.name: Quisana
runners.spotlight: Similar form in her three starts (7f-1m, good or faster), going close at this track in May and turning in another solid effort when fifth at Doncaster last month; returning to 1m should suit and she won't need much improvement for the addition of a hood.
runners.comment: Consistent form in three runs this summer; return to 1m/addition of a hood can help

runners.name: Fallen Logic
runners.spotlight: 125-1 when offering little short-term encouragement on last month's debut (7.3f, good).
runners.comment: 125-1 when offering little short-term encouragement on last month's debut (7.3f, good)

races.race_name: LSL Racing Horse Sales Syndication Leasing Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Dragon God
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but he has been threatening for Tony Carroll this year, most recently finishing second in a C&D handicap 19 days ago; should get a good pace to aim at and unlikely to be far away again.
runners.comment: 0-12 but threatening, most recently finishing second over C&D last month; contender

runners.name: So Smart
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; should be well treated now but that has been the case for a while and he keeps finding one or two too strong; conditions no problem and likely to give his running again; stable also run Savannah Smiles.
runners.comment: C&D winner; knocking at the door this summer while operating just below his best

runners.name: Savannah Smiles
runners.spotlight: Back on the up following a wind op in May, placed at Bath and over C&D before making all in a small-field handicap at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; a 4lb rise asks more of her but she should give another good account; stable also run So Smart.
runners.comment: Front-running Lingfield (6f, good to firm) win last month; up 4lb and more is required

runners.name: River Edge
runners.spotlight: He was returning from 736 days on the sidelines when third of eight in a 0-50 classified event over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago; tired in the closing stages on that occasion and he should last longer with the run behind him; open to improvement.
runners.comment: Promising return from long absence here two weeks ago; still not fully exposed

races.race_name: EBF / UB40 ft. Ali Campbell 24th July Restricted Novice (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Restricted Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Blondie Larry
runners.spotlight: Finished in midfield on his debut at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) last month; better form when second of eight at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 16 days later; holds leading form claims while retaining the potential for further progress.
runners.comment: Two encouraging runs last month; leading form claims and remains capable of better

runners.name: Chilli
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when fourth over C&D (soft) on debut last month; sent off the 2-1 favourite for a fillies' novice at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on the strength of it but she dropped away to finish eighth of the ten runners (jockey reported the filly boiled over in the preliminaries); now wears a hood; can do better.
runners.comment: Failed to build on the promise of her C&D debut when 8th at Newbury latest; now hooded

runners.name: Amber Ocean
runners.spotlight: Promising start to her career when second of eight in an early-season fillies' maiden at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) 101 days ago; the winner and third from that race are both decent performers and she looks a likely type on her return from a break.
runners.comment: Debut second looks stronger now than it did at the time; open to improvement; contender

runners.name: Secret Rival
runners.spotlight: Held back by inexperience in her two runs so far, showing better form at the second attempt when sixth of ten at Newbury (6f, good to firm) 23 days ago; needs more to feature but that isn't out of the question.
runners.comment: Green in both starts; open to improvement though and 5f on quick ground could suit

runners.name: Chianti
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 5f runs last month (gelded after debut, a race for which he was sent off the 15-8 favourite); still early days but nurseries may provide richer pickings.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 5f runs last month; nurseries may provide richer pickings

runners.name: Norham
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; fourth foal; brother to winners Nemonte (6f/7.4f 2yo; RPR 83) and Dahlia Noir (1m; 79); dam Listed-placed 1m-12.5f winner (92), half-sister to 1m2f 2yo Group 1 winner Tennessee Stud; bred to need a bit more of a test than this but he is starting out at a realistic level; market should be instructive.
runners.comment: 65,000euros brother to two winners out of a well-related winner; market instructive

runners.name: Percy Shaw
runners.spotlight: 28-1 for both starts, running to a similar modest RPR in the process; hopes appear to rest on the drop to 5f and switch to faster ground sparking some improvement.
runners.comment: Modest RPRs in two novice events over further; new trip/ground not enough to tempt

runners.name: Cash Flow Boy
runners.spotlight: Dropped away to finish seventh of eight (Blondie Larry second) in a 5f novice at Windsor 19 days ago; open to improvement but likely a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: Finished over 7l behind Blondie Larry on Windsor debut; can do better but he needs to

runners.name: Hailstones In May
runners.spotlight: Poor form in fast-ground maidens at Windsor (5f) and here (7f) this summer; can't be recommended.
runners.comment: Poor form in fast-ground maidens at Windsor (5f) and here (7f) this summer; no appeal

races.race_name: Fairplay Daily Price Boosts Handicap

runners.name: Rating
runners.spotlight: 8lb better off with Dappled Light for a half-length defeat at Bath (1m, good to firm) in May; won a small-field handicap back at Bath four days later but two runs in Class 5 events since haven't been so good; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Chance on this season's best but below that level in Class 5 events on last two starts

runners.name: Stenmark
runners.spotlight: 7f AW win for Denis Quinn last season; running well for his new trainer too, most recently finishing a neck second at Epsom (good to firm) last week; runs off the same mark (1lb well in) and he is respected, for all his stamina for 1m has to be conclusively proven.
runners.comment: Neck 2nd at Epsom (7f) last week; good form chance but stamina for 1m still to be proven

runners.name: Dappled Light
runners.spotlight: Picked up a couple of Class 6 events at Bath this summer and he wasn't beaten far in his hat-trick bid at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) 16 days ago; another 2lb higher today but this C&D winner should give it another good go.
runners.comment: In rude health this summer; up in class but this C&D winner should make another bold bid

runners.name: Penelope Valentine
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner who ran her best race on turf when second of seven, beaten a neck, at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in May; failed to back it up at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm; cheekpieces rather than visor) four weeks ago; this trip should be more suitable.
runners.comment: Four AW wins and ran best race on turf when 2nd at Nottingham in May; not so good latest

runners.name: Kodi Fire
runners.spotlight: Well placed to rattle off a fast-ground hat-trick last summer (7f/1m); this campaign has been harder work but he fared a bit better last time, is down to a winning mark and now wears cheekpieces for the first time; not solid, but a revival wouldn't be a complete bolt from the blue.
runners.comment: Completed a fast-ground hat-trick last summer; quiet in 2026 but headgear now tried

runners.name: Echalar
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race for this yard when keeping on for third in a C&D handicap 19 days ago; now has something to build on and Billy Loughnane a positive booking for the stable.
runners.comment: Best run for new yard when third over C&D 19 days ago; Billy Loughnane booked; contender

races.race_name: Bet Now With fairplaybet.co.uk Handicap

runners.name: King Of The Dance
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner; did score over C&D last July off a 3lb higher mark though and his latest Ffos Las second (7.3f, good) was a sound run; each-way shout.
runners.comment: C&D win last July off 3lb lower; fair second at Ffos Las latest; each-way shout

runners.name: Ravenglass
runners.spotlight: Strong at the finish when winning a C&D handicap last May off 1lb higher; retains all his ability, in the frame on his last two start, and going back over this trip will suit; one of two runners for the stable.
runners.comment: C&D winner; on a handy mark and arrives in good order; high on the list

runners.name: Romanovich
runners.spotlight: Four of his seven wins have come over C&D; successful off this mark at Wolverhampton in March but not in the same form in four runs since; others look more persuasive.
runners.comment: Four-time C&D winner; on last winning mark but recent efforts have been short of his best
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould

runners.name: Autumn Angel
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner of a 6f handicap here (good to soft) in May and that has been followed by three similar efforts in defeat; creeping up the weights so she will need a bit more now back up to 7f.
runners.comment: In good form here this summer but sneaking back up the weights; more needed back at 7f

runners.name: Tomarlo
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a 6f handicap at Wolverhampton nine days ago; had form at this trip in Ireland and he comes here in preference to an intended Wolverhampton run on Tuesday; suspicion remains that he's likely to prove a cut above this level.
runners.comment: Made all over 6f on AW last week; penalised but likely a cut above this level

runners.name: Too Much Trevor
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 31st attempt when winning a 6f handicap here (soft) last month; not quite so good twice since but he is still capable of a prominent showing.
runners.comment: He has followed last month's belated first win (6f, soft) with 2 fair runs; each-way shout

runners.name: Scarfo
runners.spotlight: In good form over 1m last month, winning here (soft) before solid placed efforts both here and at Ffos Las; drops back to 7f and probably needs to improve for it.
runners.comment: In good form over 1m last month, including a course win; needs more for drop back to 7f

runners.name: Ten Club
runners.spotlight: Course winner (6f) who won decisively on AW (7f) in November off a 3lb higher mark; recent return to action should have sharpened him up; one of two strong contenders for his trainer.
runners.comment: Course winner (6f); lurks on a dangerous mark; one of two solid contenders for the yard

runners.name: Weston Court
runners.spotlight: He ran his best race for some time when second of five in a handicap over C&D (good to firm) last week; fair fourth at Bath on Wednesday but others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.comment: Back to form when 2nd over C&D last week; fair 4th at Bath yesterday; vulnerable for win

runners.name: Green Icon
runners.spotlight: Promising 2yo for Owen Burrows (RPR 83); 0-20 in Ireland for Denis Hogan, with 2026 offering no sign of a revival in his fortunes; starts out for a new yard off a lowly mark so worth a precautionary market check.
runners.comment: Promising 2yo (2-4) but went 0-20 for D Hogan in Ireland; check betting on stable debut

runners.name: Ajrad
runners.spotlight: Has three course wins over 1m but has found it tougher going this year; slowly easing in the weights but dropping back to 7f is not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Three wins here over 1m; tough going so far in 2026 & drop back to 7f not enough to tempt

runners.name: Poet
runners.spotlight: Ended a run of finishing last when seventh of 11 at Brighton nine days ago; easy enough to swerve.
runners.comment: Out of sorts for some time now and he is easy enough to swerve

races.race_name: DragonBet Welsh Racing Festival 9TH-11th Ooctober Handicap

runners.name: Be An Angel
runners.spotlight: The addition of cheekpieces saw her return to winning ways in a five-runner apprentice handicap at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) five days ago; 2lb well in but this is a deeper race.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces worked the oracle at Salisbury five days ago; no penalty but this is tougher

runners.name: Zoulu Warrior
runners.spotlight: 5f win here (good ground) last August and he added two AW victories to his tally in December; his last two runs have been disappointing, the latest back on turf after an absence, but the return of Saffie Osborne to the saddle could perk him up (two wins and a second from the three times she has ridden him).
runners.comment: Course winner; low-key return last month but goes well for today's rider; could revive

runners.name: Outer Edge
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; shaped quite nicely at Windsor on his seasonal return but he failed to build on it at Ffos Las 17 days ago; others appeal more for the win.
runners.comment: C&D winner; failed to build on his encouraging return last time; others appeal more
runners.owner: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason

runners.name: Vape
runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and this veteran is likely to find more races this year; the evidence of his two runs in 2026 suggests he may need some more help from the handicapper before he is of renewed interest though.
runners.comment: Conditions won't faze him but his two runs in 2026 don't suggest this will be his day

runners.name: Serenity Dream
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f handicap at Kempton in January and he has run several good races since, notably a narrow defeat back at Kempton two weeks ago; Billy Loughnane retains the ride; as this 5yo showed at Ascot in May, he's a strong contender back on fast turf.
runners.comment: Best form this year on AW but he handles fast turf too; good 2nd latest; solid contender

runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.spotlight: In good form this year without managing to put his head in front; eligible for weaker races than this though and could prove vulnerable.
runners.comment: Still seeking a first win of the year and he is eligible for weaker races than this
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner

runners.name: Connie's Rose
runners.spotlight: Multiple course winner, the latest last September (6f, soft) off a 1lb lower mark; she has run some solid races in defeat this year but consistency has been an issue and others appeal more in today's field.
runners.comment: Multiple course winner; several good runs this year but others stronger for win purposes

races.race_name: Chepstow Family Fun Day 31st August Handicap

runners.name: Electric Bass
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but six times a runner-up and he also ran well in a similar race over C&D last year; his form dipped last time but that was his first run on soft ground; likely to go well.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden but often runs well and has form over C&D; one to take seriously

runners.name: Time After Time
runners.spotlight: Two 1m wins on good ground last summer, including at this track; well short of that level in two runs this year and stepping up in trip with cheekpieces added isn't enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Course win (1m) last summer; not found her best in 2026; new trip and headgear today

runners.name: Bumaan
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in three novice/maiden runs (7f/1m); much more encouragement when keeping on for second on last month's handicap debut (1m4f, AW), still looking green in the process; makes his turf debut in a weak race and with Billy Loughane back in the saddle; big chance.
runners.comment: Big step forward when second on handicap debut (1m4f, AW) last month; leading claims

runners.name: Aravalli
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Ffos Las (1m4f, good to soft) on her stable/handicap debut last month; left that well behind when springing a 33-1 surprise here (1m4f, good to firm) last week; 4lb wrong under a penalty and not obviously crying out for today's drop in distance but as a last-time winner with few miles on the clock she can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Rallied to win a 1m4f handicap here last week; drop in trip not sure to suit but unexposed

races.race_name: Best Ticket Deals Online @thirskraces Book Now Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands C/D) (GBB)

runners.name: Clementines Star
runners.spotlight: Hooded for her first three starts; third at Newcastle (6f, AW) in two starts last year and also ran well in two starts this term (turf/AW), most recently when beaten a neck at Southwell (hood removed) 11 days ago on her first try at this trip; returns to turf and she has strong claims.
runners.comment: Ran well in two starts this term, including when beaten a neck at Southwell over this trip

runners.name: Dolo's Star
runners.spotlight: Ran well when runner-up at Southwell (5f, AW) on her final start for Grant Tuer but she was tailed off in a handicap at Leicester (6f, good to firm) on her debut for this stable; steps up in trip with a bit to prove.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 6f on her final start for Grant Tuer but tailed off on her stable debut

runners.name: Princess Honey Bee
runners.spotlight: Promising third of eight on her debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) behind a subsequent Group 3 winner last summer but she was below that level on her next two starts, including when last of four at Epsom last August on her final start for Eve Johnson Houghton; absent since and the market should be informative on her stable debut.
runners.comment: Promising third on debut but below that level on next two starts; off since August

races.race_name: By Chen Presidential Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Hatamoto
runners.spotlight: Posted an improved effort when runner-up at Ripon (1m, good) last month and went one better at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm; made all) two weeks ago, form that has since been franked by the second; cheekpieces now go on and he should give it a good go from the front.
runners.comment: Beat a subsequent winner when making all at Beverley two weeks ago; cheekpieces go on

runners.name: Leelawadee
runners.spotlight: Well held on her debut at Newcastle (7f, AW) in April but she has taken a small step forward in each of her two starts since; kept on into fourth at Thirsk (7f, good) last month and could be suited by this step up to 1m on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Progressed with of her three starts (6f/7f); could be suited by this step up in trip

runners.name: Scheffler
runners.spotlight: Promising third at Lingfield (7f, AW) in March but he was well beaten on his other two outings for Richard Hughes, and he was beaten a long way on his stable/handicap debut at Carlisle (1m1f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last month; dropped 5lb.
runners.comment: Disappointing since a promising debut in March and well beaten on his yard/handicap debut

runners.name: Lady Britain
runners.spotlight: Won two nurseries at Beverley over 7.5f last August (both on good to firm) but she struggled in a competitive sales race at Doncaster (6.5f, good to soft) in September when last seen; returns off a mark 8lb higher than for that latest success but she can't be dismissed back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Won two nurseries over 7.5f at Beverley last August; well held in sales race in September

races.race_name: Sell Your Business With Anderson Barrowcliff Handicap

runners.name: Simba's Pride
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when winning at Ripon (6f, good) in May and ran well when third here over 6f two weeks ago; cheekpieces are now added but he will likely need them to go a good gallop dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: Ran well here over 6f last time but will need them to go a good gallop over this trip

runners.name: Angel Numbers
runners.spotlight: Winless since her debut but she has been runner-up on three occasions, including at Bath (5f, firm) in April; below that level on her final three starts for the Newland/Insole yard and makes her stable debut having been bought for 12,000gns.
runners.comment: Winless since her debut but has been second three times; makes her stable debut
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing Xviii And Ruth Carr

runners.name: Vinciamo
runners.spotlight: 0-6 but he went close in a novice at Catterick (5f, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) in May; behind a few of these at York last month and was beaten 6l when runner-up at Redcar four weeks ago; dropped 3lb.
runners.comment: Went close at Catterick in May but behind a few of these at York last month; dropped 3lb

runners.name: Davorge Nation
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselbugh (5f, good) last August but he's struggled on his last two outings, including on his reappearance at Leicester (5f, good) last month following a wind operation; best watched.
runners.comment: Struggled in two starts since winning at Musselburgh last August; best watched

runners.name: Yellow Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Won a fillies' novice at Musselburgh (5f, soft) on her final start for Kevin Philippart de Foy and has posted some respectable efforts for this stable, including when fourth at Newcastle three weeks ago; place claims.
runners.comment: Has posted some respectable efforts for this stable, including when fourth at Newcastle

runners.name: Empress Olivia
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at Ripon over 6f, the most recent on good to soft in April; reported to have bled from the nose when failing to beat a rival at York (5f, good) in first-time cheekpieces (discarded) last month and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Both wins over 6f at Ripon; reported to have bled from the nose at York last month

runners.name: Under The Radar
runners.spotlight: Sole win came over this C&D last May on his second start and he ran respectably when sixth of 12 here in May; however, he's run below that level in two starts since and needs to bounce back returned to this track.
runners.comment: C&D last May on his second start; below his best in recent outings and bounce back needed

runners.name: Straight Ahead
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with two wins on the AW at Newcastle and reappeared with a good fourth over this C&D in May; failed to build on that at York (5f, good) last month but now drops in grade.
runners.comment: Dual AW winner; good fourth over C&D on reappearance but below that level at York

runners.name: Houndhill
runners.spotlight: Had a visor on for the first time when winning at Newcastle (5f, AW) in May but he's been well beaten in both starts since, including here over 6f last time; headgear is now discarded.
runners.comment: Well beaten in both starts since winning at Newcastle in May; headgear now discarded
runners.owner: J Raybould N Skinner D Jenkins

races.race_name: Don't Miss Summer Family Days @thirskraces Classified Stakes

runners.name: Trucial Pearl
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 12th attempt when beating seven rivals in a handicap at Ripon (1m, good) four weeks ago; that was her first go over 1m and she drops into a classified event with solid claims.
runners.comment: Off the mark at the 12th attempt when winning a handicap at Ripon four weeks ago

runners.name: Copper And Five
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who was runner-up over 8.5f at Beverley in April and May; below his best over that same C&D last month but has good claims on his first try in classified company.
runners.comment: C&D winner; below his best last time but has good claims on his first try in a classified
runners.owner: Mrs Sally Doyle And Mrs Ruth Carr

runners.name: Aspire To Glory
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes, the most recent coming at Chelmsford last August; 5lb lower than for that success but he's been well held in four starts since joining this stable.
runners.comment: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes but well held in four starts for this stable

runners.name: Regal Knight
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but he did run one of his better races when third of seven at Beverley (8.5f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) two weeks ago; claims if backing that up in a switch of headgear.
runners.comment: 0-8 but ran one of his better races when third at Beverley two weeks ago
runners.owner: D Bishop P Robinson S Bland T Coyle

runners.name: I Can Boogy
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner, the most recent in a classified at Newcastle (1m, AW) in February; ran well there three weeks ago and has to be considered returned to this level.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle in February and ran well there three weeks ago; has to be considered

runners.name: Langholm
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner; got up late to win a handicap at Beverley (7.5f, good) last month and ran another respectable race when fourth in a classified event at Ayr (1m; Park Lane Penny was second) 11 days ago; claims.
runners.comment: Got up late to win at Beverley last month but behind Park Lane Penny at Ayr last time

runners.name: Park Lane Penny
runners.spotlight: Struggled on her first three starts but posted an improved effort when narrowly beaten in a classified event at Ayr (1m, good) 11 days ago; showed signs of inexperience that day (hung left) and looks capable of going one better.
runners.comment: Posted an improved effort when narrowly beaten in a classified event at Ayr last time

runners.name: Create
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 1m at Southwell last year; struggled on her first four outings this term but returned to some form when fourth of 18 at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) last month; needs to build on that.
runners.comment: Returned to some form in a handicap at Doncaster last month but needs to build on that
runners.owner: Dixon, Wylam, M Baldry, J&s Harrod

runners.name: Queenies Pal
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who failed to improved for the addition of a tongue-tie (retained) at Ayr (1m, soft) last month; better needed.
runners.comment: 0-8 and failed to improve for the addition of a tongue-tie (retained) at Ayr last time

runners.name: Can I Kiss You
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who was runner-up at Gowran Park (1m, good to yielding) in May but below that level in both starts since, including when last of 14 on her yard debut at Beverley (8.5f, good) a month ago.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish maiden who failed to beat a rival home on her yard debut at Beverley last month

runners.name: Without Delay
runners.spotlight: The most recent of her five wins came at Catterick last July; third there over 7f in May but she's struggled in three outings since, including back at Catterick eight days ago; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Third at Catterick in May but she's struggled in three outings since; others preferred

runners.name: Bridgefoot Rambler
runners.spotlight: Struggled in novice/maiden company on her first three starts and it was the same story in a classified event at Leicester (7f, good; first-time cheekpieces) last month; blinkers need to make a difference.
runners.comment: Struggled in each of her four starts and first-time blinkers need to make a difference

runners.name: Here Comes Louie
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on his first three starts (1m/1m4f) but he was beaten only 3l when sixth of ten on his handicap debut at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) last month; should have more to offer but didn't look to be crying out for this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Beaten only 3l on his h'cap debut but didn't look to be crying out for this shorter trip

races.race_name: Meijer Celebration Cup Handicap

runners.name: Elashgar
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in February and was runner-up there over 5f on his next start; below his best on turf on his last two outings and has a bit to prove on this surface on his first try over 7f.
runners.comment: Won a handicap at Wolverhampton in February; unproven on turf following two lesser runs

runners.name: Emerald Army
runners.spotlight: Course winner last April when trained by Declan Carroll; runner-up in two of his six starts since joining this stable and shaped as if still in form when sixth of eight at Catterick (7f, good to firm) 24 days ago; can go well if things drop right (usually held up).
runners.comment: Course winner over 6f; shaped as if still in form when sixth at Catterick last time

runners.name: Coconut Bay
runners.spotlight: Won four times last year, the most recent coming at Catterick off a 9lb higher mark than today's; her last two efforts have been solid and she's an each-way contender.
runners.comment: 9lb below her last winning mark; last two efforts have been solid and she's an e-w player

runners.name: Crown Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Beaten 13l when sixth of 12 on her debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in April and has been well beaten in both starts since (7.5f/7f); makes her handicap debut with better needed.
runners.comment: Beaten 13l on her debut on the AW and well beaten on turf in both starts since

runners.name: Misemerald
runners.spotlight: Yet to win in handicap company but she's been placed on her last two outings, most recently at Carlisle (1m, good) 12 days ago; drops back in trip with each-way claims.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but placed on her last two outings; has each-way claims

runners.name: Forever Twenty
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden whose best effort came when a 1l third of nine at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) in May; had cheekpieces on for the first time (quickly discarded) when a fair third of six at Beverley (7.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago.
runners.comment: Best effort came when third at Doncaster in May; fair effort at Beverley last time

runners.name: Captain Cess
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but he went close at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) on his final start for Adrian Wintle, and ran well at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm; didn't get the clearest run) last month on his stable debut; this trip will be no issue and he's considered.
runners.comment: Ran well on his yard debut over 5.5f and will have no issue with this trip; considered

runners.name: Night Emperor
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden but he's been shaping quite well in recent starts, including when fourth of 18 here last time over 6f, doing best of those drawn low; looks worth another try over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Did best of those drawn low when fourth of 18 here over 6f; looks worth another go at 7f

runners.name: Fair Isle Sioux
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 6yo mare who has hinted at ability in two of her three starts (6f/1m; soft/good to firm) but she was still well beaten here two weeks ago; drops back in trip on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: 6yo mare who has hinted at ability in two of her three starts; makes her handicap debut

races.race_name: Thirsk Sky Bet Summer Festival Day Friday 24th July Handicap

runners.name: Military Leader
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning at Southwell (1m, AW) in May and followed up over this C&D next time (good); has posted two good placed efforts since, the most recent at Chester (7.5f, soft) last month off a 2lb lower mark than today's, and makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Two wins this year include one over C&D; two good placed efforts since; shortlisted

runners.name: Harswell Ruby
runners.spotlight: Two wins from 29 starts, with the most recent success coming in April over this C&D; had cheekpieces back on (retained) when runner-up at Pontefract (1m, good) nine days ago and holds good claims off the same mark.
runners.comment: C&D winner in April; had cheekpieces back on when running well at Pontefract last time

runners.name: Capital Guarantee
runners.spotlight: A three-time 7f/1m winner in 2025, including over this C&D; mainly below his best this season but he didn't run too badly when sixth at Beverley (7.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago; on a handy mark and now drops in grade.
runners.comment: Mainly below his best this year but didn't run badly latest; drops in grade off handy mark

runners.name: Degale
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 12 starts came in a Ripon novice in 2024 (1m, good); hasn't been the most consistent this season and he's been well beaten on his last two outings; down to a career-low mark but others are preferred.
runners.comment: 1-12; well beaten on his last two outings; on a career-low mark but others preferred

runners.name: Barley
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner, the most recent coming at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in June 2024; placed in each of his last four starts, albeit he was below his best last time, and once again has an each-way chance.
runners.comment: Three-time winner; placed in each of his last four starts and once again has e-w claims

runners.name: Cosmos Raj
runners.spotlight: Won at Ripon (1m, soft; Barley was second) last July off a mark 8lb higher than today's but he's struggled since; others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 8lb lower than when winning at Ripon last July but has struggled since; others stronger

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Star Of State
runners.spotlight: Chased home a strongly-fancied rival from the Ger Lyons stable at Fairyhouse last week; should go one better now, since the winner had two runs under her belt and is reportedly a candidate for the valuable Ballyhane Stakes; stable maintaining terrific form.
runners.comment: Chased home a strongly-fancied rival at Fairyhouse last week, should go one better now

runners.name: Dear Theodosia
runners.spotlight: (E6,000 vendor Y); second foal; half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Nakamura; unraced dam closely related to 5f-1m winner Bernie's Boy, half-sister to useful 5f-7f winner Gentlemen; hooded for debut; in good hands but best watched.
runners.comment: Failed to sell as a yearling, half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Nakamura, hooded for debut

runners.name: Scotty Cameron
runners.spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother by the speedy Caturra to three winners; dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner, half-sister to 6f 2yo Listed winner System.
runners.comment: 50,000gns yearling; sixth foal, half-brother by the speedy Caturra to three winners

runners.name: Someday Somewhere
runners.spotlight: E16,000 Y, £45,000 2yo; third foal; half-sister to Polish 1m winner Cotai Spirit; dam placed 7f AW 2yo, half-sister to 6f 2yo winner Lajooje, out of 7f/1m Listed winning half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Equiano.
runners.comment: GBP45,000 Breeze Up purchase, pedigree suggests this trip should be fine for her debut

runners.name: Not You Too
runners.spotlight: 125,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-sister by top-class juvenile sprinter Perfect Power to useful Group-placed winner Thunder Of Niagara, and to a minor 1m winner; dam placed, half-sister to US 1m4f Grade 3 winner Dress Rehearsal.
runners.comment: 125,000gns yearling, half-sister by Perfect Power to a useful Group-placed winner

runners.name: This That
runners.spotlight: 65,000gns yearling; Sergei Prokofiev colt is the first foal out of an unraced half-sister to French 6f 2yo Listed winner Royal Grey, out of 6f 2yo Group 2 winner; trainer introduced a smart juvenile at this venue last week.
runners.comment: 65,000gns yearling by Sergei Prokofiev, trainer introduced a smart juvenile here last week

runners.name: El Domino
runners.spotlight: E25,000 yearling; third foal; half-brother by Ardad to two winners; dam 6f winner, half-sister to 6f Listed winner Bounty Box; one of two here for the stable, a senior jockey aboard.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Ardad to two winners; dam 6f winner, selected of two here for the stable

runners.name: Magma King
runners.spotlight: Failed to sell at 50,000gns as a yearling; second foal; half-brother by Pinatubo to a 5f/6f winner in Britain and Hong Kong; dam 1m AW 2yo winner.
runners.comment: Failed to sell at 50,000gns as a yearling, half-brother by Pinatubo to a 5f/6f winner

runners.name: Whosinterviewinwho
runners.spotlight: Fair first effort at Roscommon with this rider aboard; stable's newcomer has a senior rider aboard; will probably need a handicap mark.
runners.comment: Fair first effort at Roscommon with this rider aboard, will probably need a handicap mark

runners.name: Siege Of Tyre
runners.spotlight: Gave problems at the start and never showed with a chance first time out at Cork.
runners.comment: Gave problems at the start and never showed with a chance first time out at Cork

runners.name: Little Diva
runners.spotlight: Made late headway from an unpromising position at Bellewstown; longer trip should suit, but needs to find considerable improvement.
runners.comment: Made late headway from an unpromising position at Bellewstown, longer trip should suit

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Sea Of Rain
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite at Roscommon on debut, fourth behind a rival who had run twice; went within a whisker of opening her account over C&D on second start, beaten by a Jessica Harrington-trained favourite; beaten favourite for a second time at Roscommon; obvious prospects here, since she should again have the measure of Jezzie Bea and Ballyskeagh.
runners.comment: Runner-up twice, holds an edge over Jezzie Bea and Ballyskeagh on Roscommon running

runners.name: Bold Move
runners.spotlight: Made some late headway over C&D on debut; potential for improvement but no reason why he should reverse form with runner-up Sea Of Rain.
runners.comment: Made some late headway over C&D on debut, safely held by runner-up Sea Of Rain

runners.name: Old Joanie
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run at a huge price on debut at the Curragh, will benefit from more experience.
runners.comment: Not a bad run at a huge price on debut at the Curragh, will benefit from more experience

runners.name: Jezzie Bea
runners.spotlight: Left an impression that she still had plenty to learn when keeping on well at Roscommon on debut; fourth placing was promising in the circumstances; may get closer to runner-up Sea Of Rain; same remark could apply to fifth-placed Ballyskeagh.
runners.comment: Looked raw first time out at Roscommon, fourth placing was promising in the circumstances

runners.name: Razmataz
runners.spotlight: Cheap purchase; third in Naas barrier trial in May; slowly into stride and never a factor at Fairyhouse (6f) last month; failed to improve in a 5f maiden at Bellewstown and now fitted with a hood.
runners.comment: Has struggled in races at Naas and Bellewstown, can be ruled out

runners.name: Grit And Glory
runners.spotlight: Cost 20,000 euros as a yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Determined Effort (US 5f turf) and Karacrown (Mexican 2yo); dam French Listed-placed 1m 2yo/US 8.5f turf winner (RPR 98), half-sister to French 1m Listed winner Night Bokbel; jockey booking is noteworthy.
runners.comment: Seventh foal, half-brother to winners in US and Mexico, dam a French Listed-placed winner

runners.name: Williamsburg
runners.spotlight: Cost 42,000 euros as a yearling; tenth foal and half-brother to four winners; pedigree is perhaps more middle distance-oriented; one of two newcomers, both by Without Parole, for his trainer.
runners.comment: Tenth foal, half-brother to four winners, one of two newcomers here for his trainer

runners.name: Mirren
runners.spotlight: Cost 30,000gns as a yearling; half-brother to seven winners over distances between 7f and 1m2f; dam French 1m 2yo winner
runners.comment: Tenth foal; half-brother to seven winners, dam a French 1m 2yo winner

runners.name: Hypiradon
runners.spotlight: Cost 40,000 euros as a yearling;; third foal; half-brother by Cotai Glory to 6f winner Ceo Stealth Mode; dam unraced half-sister to winners Gangster Granny (Flat and hurdles) and Ballinea Star (6f 2yo Group 3), out of Group-placed 6f 2yo winner; potentially interesting.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 6f winner, dam an unraced half-sister to smart juvenile Ballinea Star

runners.name: Ballyskeagh
runners.spotlight: Ran green and did not get a clear passage at Roscommon; has a bit to find with Sea Of Rain (second) and Jezzie Bea (fourth); could feature with normal progress.
runners.comment: Ran green and did not get a clear passage at Roscommon, could feature with normal progress

runners.name: Gwen
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced at a big price on her introduction at the Curragh; might be one for handicaps in due course, if building on that.
runners.comment: Not disgraced at a big price on her introduction at the Curragh, may need more experience

runners.name: Star Glory
runners.spotlight: Got upset in the stalls on debut at the Curragh; merit in her run in the circumstances, keeping on to finish sixth of 12; withdrawn after a stalls issue here last time; significant element of risk with that in mind.
runners.comment: Got upset in the stalls on debut, merit in her run, withdrawn after stalls issue last time

races.race_name: Bulmers Live At Leopardstown Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Bear Right
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame on her last three starts; does not need much to improve from her recent close-up third at Fairyhouse; addition of cheekpieces may provide that little bit extra that she needs to get her head in front for the first time.
runners.comment: Does not need much to improve from her recent close-up third at Fairyhouse to win a race

runners.name: Ardadslosttheplot
runners.spotlight: Placed over 7f on the second of three maiden starts at two; disappointing on only nursery attempt; after losing a prominent position, finished well for this rider to take third over 5f at Naas on her seasonal debut; every chance she can feature over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Finished well for this rider to take third over 5f at Naas, every chance she can feature

runners.name: Notforalongtime
runners.spotlight: Prolific AW winner (9-32); off-putting 1-31 record on turf; placed this season at Cork and the Curragh; below best on three most recent starts.
runners.comment: Prolific AW winner (9-32), off-putting 1-31 record on turf, placed twice this season

runners.name: Dynamic Force
runners.spotlight: Last win came in a 1m Killarney claimer in 2024; fifth in a claimer last time at Bellewstown, only 24 hours after finishing fourth in a handicap at the same venue; overall handicap form has been satisfactory; needs to raise his game
runners.comment: Fifth in a claimer last time, handicap form has been satisfactory, needs to raise his game

runners.name: Faoladh
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a good spell last summer, including a win and a short-head second in two outings over 1m here in June; twice made the frame over 1m here this year before winning over this trip at Down Royal in May; out of the money twice since then.
runners.comment: Out of the money twice since winning off 4lb lower at Down Royal, others preferred

runners.name: Rodeeve
runners.spotlight: Went up 12lb for a Fairyhouse success last month; beat subsequent winner Monastere then; however, unable to sustain her improvement when down the field at the same venue at the beginning of the month; held by Bear Right on that evidence.
runners.comment: Went up 12lb for a Fairyhouse success, well held by Bear Right on subsequent evidence

runners.name: God Knows
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with fine second placings at Down Royal and the Curragh; especially good effort behind the progressive Syzygy on the second occasion; no sign of similar form in three starts this term.
runners.comment: Ended last season with two fine second placings, no sign of similar form this term

runners.name: Dawn Flame
runners.spotlight: AW winner over 1m; that had seemed like a flash in the pan until a revival in form when third behind the well-fancied Glen Breeze at Limerick last Saturday; 2lb wrong here but not without a chance of reaching the money.
runners.comment: AW winner over 1m, good effort when third at Limerick last Saturday, 2lb wrong here

runners.name: Ardeur
runners.spotlight: Won 6f maiden for Ralph Beckett and later some decent efforts in defeat in France up to 1m2f; weak Irish form, in rear on both starts this season.
runners.comment: Showed ability in Britain and France, weak Irish form, in rear on both starts this season

runners.name: Comfort Line
runners.spotlight: Heavily-raced gelding; gained a tenth career win at Dundalk in April and seems to be holding his form well; 3l second at the Curragh and a fair fifth at Bellewstown 13 days ago; 0-11 record at this venue is a negative, placed three times.
runners.comment: Heavily-raced gelding, gained a tenth career win in April and seems to be holding his form

runners.name: Mehmar
runners.spotlight: Was in the form of his life around this time two seasons ago with back-to-back 6f wins for Michael O'Callaghan; signs of a revival when seventh of 21 at Naas last month; needs to provide further reassurance to become a betting proposition.
runners.comment: Was in the form of his life around this time two seasons ago, signs of a revival at Naas

runners.name: Prime Sign
runners.spotlight: Last season's 50-1 success in a 27-runner 6f contest at the Curragh now looks like a fluke; hard to fancy on this season's form; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Last season's 50-1 success at the Curragh now looks like a fluke, hard to fancy

runners.name: Smaoineamh Sile
runners.spotlight: Five-time turf winner; out of sorts on AW last winter, unseated rider at start on reappearance at Bellewstown 13 days ago; jockey booking is the main positive.
runners.comment: Five-time turf winner, out of sorts on AW last winter, unseated rider at start on return

runners.name: Cordouan
runners.spotlight: Just one placed effort from eight starts last season; tailed off at the Curragh on his return and down the field at Roscommon two months ago; not a big price on the second occasion, so perhaps capable of better.
runners.comment: Just one placed effort from eight starts last season, no encouragement from two 2026 runs

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Sarah's Choice
runners.spotlight: Cost 100,000 euros at the breeze-ups and is speedily bred; 10-1, caught late over 1m at Naas in Listed race won by rival now rated 89, so it's not form to get carried away with and had a relatively hard race into the bargain; backs up fairly quickly as well, but obviously has a good level of ability.
runners.comment: 10-1, caught late over 1m at Naas in Listed race won by rival now rated 89

runners.name: So Lovely
runners.spotlight: By Wootton Bassett; first living foal out of Love, who won on her third start at two before going on to win the Moyglare, and completed the 1,000 Guineas/Oaks double the following year; holds a Moyglare entry.
runners.comment: By Wootton Bassett; first living foal out of 1,000 Guineas/Oaks winner Love; Group 1 entry
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Thelymitra
runners.spotlight: Daughter of Australia was bought back for 18,000 euro at the yearling sales; closely related to 6f/7f winner Orchidaceae (inc 2yo; RPR 98), half-sister to 1m AW winner Another Day Done; dam 7f 2yo winner, half-sister to 7f 2yo Listed winner Mountain Bear; stable second-string and no fancy entries.
runners.comment: Daughter of Australia is closely related to 6f/7f winner Orchidaceae (inc 2yo; RPR 98)

runners.name: Bellesque
runners.spotlight: St Mark's Basilica half-sister to eight winners including Australian Group 2 winner Adjusted; dam won over 1m1f in France; first home in a barrier trial before last week's debut here over 7f; 7-2, finished off well when second to a promising type; entered in the Group 1 Moyglare; slightly unusual that she's out again so quickly.
runners.comment: 7-2, finished off well when second to a promising type over 7f here last week
runners.owner: Mrs E Irwin & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Exceptionally
runners.spotlight: By multiple champion US sire Into Mischief; half-sister to five winners, notably Derby winner City Of Troy, out of a Group 1 winner; 16-1, slowly away and never got in to it at the Curragh in 7f maiden where stablemates were first and second; entered in the Moyglare, though, and no surprise to see a much better showing this time.
runners.comment: 16-1, slowly away and never got into 7f Curragh maiden where stable had first two home
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Amsterdam's Law
runners.spotlight: Good American pedigree and cost $150,000 as a yearling; 25s, prominent until weakening quickly 1f out in hot 6f maiden at the Curragh on Guineas weekend.
runners.comment: 25s, prominent until weakening quickly in hot 6f maiden at the Curragh on Guineas weekend

races.race_name: Dublin To Bahrain Handicap

runners.name: Aviatrice
runners.spotlight: Unlucky a few times on turf last year, but won three times at Dundalk, notably when beating subsequent Group 2 winner Jancis in a Listed contest over this trip; favourite/joint favourite all three outings in premier handicaps this term, twice running well at the Curragh over 6f/7f; mark remains 7lb lower than AW rating; doesn't usually lead, but can race handily.
runners.comment: Fav/jt-fav in three premier handicaps this term, twice running well at the Curragh

runners.name: How'sthebai
runners.spotlight: Likeable 3yo; won AW maiden last year; good fourth in hot Naas handicap over 1m before making most to beat in-form rival over 1m1f on probably unsuitably soft ground here; had that rival a little further back when fourth in 1m1f premier handicap at the Curragh, where missing a beat at the start proved costly in a race where the leaders didn't come back; takes on older horses for the first time.
runners.comment: Fourth over 1m1f at the Curragh, where missing a beat at the start proved costly

runners.name: Loughrea
runners.spotlight: Front-running second over this trip at Gowran leaves him with a little bit to find with How'sthebai on a line through the winner; went one better at the Curragh, and third's subsequent run suggests this opening mark is about right; scratched at Killarney on Monday due to ground described as good.
runners.comment: Curragh maiden winner, and third's subsequent run suggests opening mark is about right

runners.name: Tachos
runners.spotlight: Will like the ground; won over 1m1f here last year and has dropped back to just 1lb higher mark; ground too soft first two starts this year; latest 6l Curragh defeat can be marked up somewhat (upset in stalls and met some interference) and generally runs this track well.
runners.comment: Won over 1m1f here last year, now just 1lb higher; bit better latest and runs track well

runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.spotlight: Nine wins in all, but only one on turf from 32 starts; led when third over 7f at Fairyhouse last week, and that's probably his optimum trip on turf, rather than the stiff mile here; unplaced all four runs here, too.
runners.comment: Nine wins in all, but only one on turf from 32 starts; third over 7f at Fairyhouse latest
runners.owner: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness

runners.name: Quatre Bras
runners.spotlight: Three wins on AW, but 0-21 on turf; did well at Dundalk over the winter and carried that form through to soft-ground contests in the spring; second over 7f at Naas and fourth over 1m2f here in April (strong form); not so good since; likes to come from off the pace, and there wasn't enough on when he was fourth (only 7-2) at Killarney on Monday.
runners.comment: Likes to come from off the pace, and wasn't enough on when he was fourth at Killarney

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Meld Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Snellen
runners.spotlight: Three starts at Royal Ascot have yielded a win in the 2023 Chesham (7f), an excellent second of 23 in the Kensington Palace (1m) last year, and a creditable fifth in last month's Duke of Cambridge (1m); produced her best display on home soil when beating the odds-on Purview in this race 12 months ago; began this season with a solid third in a 7f Group 3 at this track.
runners.comment: Won this race last year, bright start to the season over 7f, satisfactory Royal Ascot run

runners.name: Geryon
runners.spotlight: Smart Curragh form at two; beat top-class filly Kensington Lane on debut and then finished second in Group 2 races won by Constitution River and Hawk Mountain; 2026 form includes links to top-class performers Thesecretadversary and Causeway; a promoted second behind Isaac Newton in a 1m1f Listed event at Navan; reversed form with that rival on latest.
runners.comment: Boasts form linked to several of the best of Ireland's Classic generation, respected

runners.name: Isaac Newton
runners.spotlight: Goodwood maiden winner on debut last August (7f, good to soft); creditable run in Group 1 at Saint-Cloud (1m2f, very soft) in October; moderate efforts first two runs this term; back on song when winning a 1m1f Listed race at Navan (Geryon promoted to second); lost a lot of ground at the start when failing to confirm form with Geryon at the Curragh last time.
runners.comment: Promoted winner at Navan with Geryon second, lost his chance at the start at the Curragh

runners.name: Syzygy
runners.spotlight: Progressive handicapper on heavy ground late last season; began this season with an excellent third in the 25-runner Irish Lincoln; placed in a 1m handicap at this venue in April; career-best on latest when chasing home stablemate and subsequent Group 3 winner Duckadilly in a 1m Listed race at Navan; 50-1 then, and is the outsider on figures here.
runners.comment: Useful handicap form, career-best with Listed second last time, tough task in this company

runners.name: Adelaide River
runners.spotlight: Second in the Irish Derby and Grand Prix de Paris for Aidan O'Brien in 2023; mostly below that level in Australia, apart from a nose second in 1m2f Group 3 at Randwick last September; marked his return to Ireland with a pleasing staying-on third to Minnie Hauk in 1m2f Curragh Group 2 (good) in May; failed to feature in Royal Ascot's Wolferton Stakes.
runners.comment: Smart 1m4f form at three, contrasting signals from two runs since return from Australia

runners.name: Cowardofthecounty
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner over 7f at Deauville as a 2yo; lost way last season but back to form this term; runner-up to City Of Memphis in conditions race at Gowran (7f, soft) and won conditions race at Fairyhouse (7f, good); fair third of six in a 1m Listed race at the Curragh on latest.
runners.comment: Very useful form at two, lost his way last season, back to form this term, a bit to prove

races.race_name: Mervue Equine Handicap

runners.name: Marmeladova
runners.spotlight: Ballinrobe maiden winner was a length off Daler back there last month (now 1lb better off); seemingly outstayed over 1m4f last time; touched off at Navan last year, so she goes left-handed; handicapped to win when everything falls into place.
runners.comment: A length off Daler at Ballinrobe (1lb better off); seemingly outstayed over 1m4f last time

runners.name: Neo Smart
runners.spotlight: Gained her second AW win off 72 in February, but just 1-28 on turf; good fourth of 20 over 1m at the Curragh last time; best form over 7f/1m, and just one inconclusive run over this trip here last year; yet to finish in the first three in five visits to this venue.
runners.comment: Gained her second AW win off 72 in February, but just 1-28 on turf; track record not great

runners.name: Sinbad My Dad
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 26 Flat starts was over 1m1f in lower-grade contest here last August; that is possibly his optimum trip, although only beaten half-a-length over 10.5f on AW in December; after five months off, not a bad run at Roscommon lately.
runners.comment: Sole win in 26 Flat starts was here over 1m1f in lower-grade contest last August
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Butler & John A Griffin & Mrs Bernadette Fahey

runners.name: Faro Island
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come right-handed on yielding ground, over 1m3f last year and under a brilliant ride from the champion jockey over 9.5f at Gowran last month; has run well this way round, too; handled quick ground okay when ridden to get 1m4f (upped to this grade) at the Curragh last time; cheekpieces swapped for blinkers.
runners.comment: Both wins have come right-handed on yielding ground, but has run well this way round, too

runners.name: Blackjack Hills
runners.spotlight: Came good late in his three-year-old campaign when the blinds went on; back-to-back wins in 0-60 company at Gowran (1m, heavy) and  Dundalk (10.5f); after eight months off, ran okay when upgraded to this level, finishing pretty much upsides Unterberg and Sinbad My Dad at Roscommon (10.5f).
runners.comment: Came good late in his three-year-old campaign when the blinds went on; ran okay on return

runners.name: Unterberg
runners.spotlight: Loves Dundalk and won three in a row there in the spring (10.5f/1m4f); sole turf win came here last summer over 1m1f (off 60) and will be sharper for Roscommon run after nearly three months off; AW mark of 87; turf mark of 78 reflects his good AW form earlier in the year, rather than his actual achievements on grass.
runners.comment: Six wins at Dundalk; sole turf win came here over 1m1f; mark might be a bit too high now

runners.name: Daler
runners.spotlight: AW winner surprised his trainer when handling soft ground here last month, beating Monday's ready Killarney winner Molto Amichi over 1m1f in first-time cheekpieces; winner got first run on him at Ballinrobe over almost this far, where he kept on well along with third-home Marmeladova.
runners.comment: Course winner over 1m1f; a length in front of Marmeladova when second at Ballinrobe

runners.name: Out On Friday
runners.spotlight: Veteran front-runner won over 1m4f at Roscommon last year and was second at Fairyhouse in May; all eight wins have been at right-handed tracks; has to be opposed here.
runners.comment: Veteran front-runner; all eight wins have been at right-handed tracks; has to be opposed

runners.name: En Or
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins for this yard, including over 1m6f and 2m; unplaced in five starts on the level since winning over 10.5f on AW in late 2024, but was placed in a maiden hurdle in February; has gone to Galway the last three years, and this is most likely a prep run.
runners.comment: Has gone to Galway the last three years, and this is most likely a prep run

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Home Of The Early Payout Handicap

runners.name: Tatum
runners.spotlight: Placed at two before missing 3yo season; two wins here last year, including corresponding contest (Ob La Di well-held fourth); not seen after that until fair comeback over 1m2f here in May, and 2m1f may have stretched her at Limerick; only 4lb higher than last year; likes it good, but scratched because of quick ground last time.
runners.comment: Two wins here last year, including corresponding contest; only 4lb higher for repeat bid

runners.name: Ob La Di
runners.spotlight: Both wins in August, so coming into her time of year; money for her when fourth over 1m2f here in May, and stayed on from rear when fifth in the Ladies Derby over 1m2f at the Curragh, a race won by well-backed stablemate; that run might have sweetened her up and she can reverse placings with third-placed Cooley's Mist; hampered when fourth to Tatum in last year's renewal; has won over 1m4f.
runners.comment: Stayed on, under a mostly hand ride, to be fifth in Ladies Derby over 1m2f at the Curragh

runners.name: Derry Lad
runners.spotlight: Latest of four wins was over 1m4f three years ago, but he's on a good mark nowadays and came home well when around 3l fifth to Killyclogher Rose at Naas (1m3f); she's a lot less exposed though, and he might struggle to turn around that form.
runners.comment: Around 3l fifth to Killyclogher Rose at Naas (1m3f); winner is a lot less exposed, though,

runners.name: Cala Bonita
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m at Gowran last summer, and twice in the autumn over 10.5f at Dundalk; return over 1m4f was respectable; slow to stride and weakened tamely over 1m2f at Navan on Saturday; tongue-tie and blinkers worn then replaced by the cheekpieces worn for AW wins; stamina on dam's side of pedigree, but not sure to stay this far.
runners.comment: Slow to stride and weakened tamely over 1m2f at Navan on Saturday; not sure to stay 1m5f

runners.name: Cooley's Mist
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 4-y-o; fourth in big-field handicap over 1m1f here last summer when with Natalia Lupini; placed twice last month, again over 1m1f here and when third in Ladies Derby at the Curragh,  a length in front of Ob La Di; stamina is the concern (not bred to stay this far).
runners.comment: Third in Ladies Derby at the Curragh, a length in front of Ob La Di; stamina a concern

runners.name: Killyclogher Rose
runners.spotlight: Placed over 1m4f on AW and, after five months off, wasn't stopping when 20-1 winner of first  handicap at Naas (1m3f, good); by a Derby winner and dam (by Dubawi) won over 10.5f; should stay and obvious chance.
runners.comment: Wasn't stopping when 20-1 winner of first handicap at Naas (1m3f, good); obvious chance

races.race_name: INCO Broking Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Dawn Coming
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden placed on all five starts over hurdles at 2m-2m1f, earning a rating of 118; a shade unlucky on the Flat at Limerick last time; beaten 5.5l when third of 14 on penultimate in a maiden hurdle at Cork; longer trip and good ground are queries; tongue tie goes on.
runners.comment: Rated 118, placed in all five starts over hurdles, trip/ground queries here, tongue tie on
runners.owner: Ms P Twiss & J Twiss & M O'Sullivan & S Nevin Twiss

runners.name: Early Dawning
runners.spotlight: Very promising start when a close third in valuable Fairyhouse bumper (2m, sft-hvy) in April 2025; not seen again until a 4.5l fourth of five back at Fairyhouse (2m, yielding) in January; now steps up in trip for hurdling debut after another absence with Townend up; could go well.
runners.comment: Promise in both bumpers at Fairyhouse, Townend up for hurdles bow, may go well up in trip

runners.name: Roll It Roisin
runners.spotlight: Berkshire mare was pulled up and beaten 21l in two point-to-points; tongue tie is applied for rules debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Berkshire mare, no impact in two points, tongue tie on for Rules' debut, watch

runners.name: Dunaird
runners.spotlight: Affinisea gelding; 1-4 in point-to-points but the form of his win hasn't worked out; beaten 26l when second of two finishers in winners' race at Necarne latest; more needed on belated Rules' debut.
runners.comment: 1-4 in points, beaten 26l on last start in that sphere, more needed on Rules' debut

runners.name: Tyson Fury
runners.spotlight: Runner up on last two starts over hurdles; rated 117 and leading claims on paper but disappointing effort when beaten at short odds in 1m4f Limerick claimer on the Flat on latest, hanging to the right.
runners.comment: Runner up last twice over hurdles, leading claims on the figures, below par on Flat latest

runners.name: Happy Me
runners.spotlight: 0-15 over hurdles and rated 100; has a few placed efforts to his name in maidens, but pulled up at Wexford on latest and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: 0-15 over hurdles and rated 100, pulled up at Wexford on latest, needs to bounce back

runners.name: Joly Saphir
runners.spotlight: Castle Du Berlais gelding; unsold as 3yo; half-brother to French 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner Joly Risk; dam maiden half-sister to 1m7f-2m5f chase winner Joly Maker; best watched on debut unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Castle Du Berlais gelding, half-brother to French winner, watch unless market speaks

runners.name: Grabat
