runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in a Kilbeggan bumper on debut a month ago when a 12-1 shot; likely best watched upped in trip for hurdling bow.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on debut in Kilbeggan bumper last month, watch on hurdling bow

runners.name: Eyecanboogie
runners.spotlight: Remote third in a Kilbeggan bumper on debut for Willie Mullins; poor form so far for this yard, including in maiden hurdles the last twice; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Poor form so far for this yard, heavy maiden hurdle defeats last twice, hard to fancy

races.race_name: D. Ivo O'Sullivan Memorial Irish EBF Mares Hurdle

runners.name: Birdie Or Bust
runners.spotlight: 2-7 over hurdles and some smart form in the book; better known as a chaser these days, but has been out of sorts in that sphere on recent starts; third at Punchestown on latest, but was still beaten over 9l; needs to revive on first run over timber since March 2024.
runners.comment: Out of sorts over fences recently, first run over timber since March 2024, revival needed

runners.name: Murcia
runners.spotlight: Grade 1 winner at Aintree (2m1f, gd-sft) in April 2025; regained the winning thread in mares' race at Listowel (16.5f, good) on latest (Grainne A Chroi 6.25l behind); the one to beat on ratings, but has never run beyond 2m1f so she has stamina to prove (mixed messages in pedigree).
runners.comment: Grade 1 winner in April 2025, back to winning ways latest, stamina to prove up in trip

runners.name: Diamond Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Solid placed graded form in France on testing ground; shed the maiden tag for this stable at Ludlow in February (2m5f, soft); not disgraced in sole start on good in the Grade 2 mares' novice at Cheltenham (2m1f); beaten 5l in Listed novice at Punchestown when last seen in April; Townend prefers Murcia.
runners.comment: Best form on soft/heavy, not disgraced on good at Cheltenham, overlooked by Townend

runners.name: Grainne A Chroi
runners.spotlight: Useful mare won a Grade 3 at Punchestown in February (2m4f, soft); outclassed in Grade 2 at Fairyhouse before finishing a 6.25l third behind Murcia over inadequate trip at Listowel (16.5f, good) on latest; this trip more her bag and may close the gap; any rain would be a plus.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner, beaten 6.25l behind Murcia latest over 2m, could get closer at this trip
runners.owner: Ms Eileen O'Brien & John Anthony Harrington

runners.name: Run For Mahler
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner, both at around 2m on good to yielding and good to firm ground; soundly beaten behind a couple of these on return from a break at Listowel in May; more needed and stamina to prove over this far.
runners.comment: Well held behind a couple of these on return at Listowel, stamina to prove up in trip

runners.name: Taketwotoone
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles and rated just 88; out of her depth in this company.
runners.comment: 0-7 over timber, rated 88, out of depth in this company

races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Uptaurintop
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose three best efforts have come on testing ground at Limerick; has a race in him, but has to prove he acts on this quicker ground.
runners.comment: Maiden, best form has come on testing ground, quicker conditions a query here

runners.name: Listentomewillya
runners.spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in maidens and similar story in first two handicaps; assessor relenting, but others have more appealing profiles.
runners.comment: Well held in maidens and in first two handicaps, mark sliding but others appeal more

runners.name: Clone Cross
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but has run well on two of last three starts; beaten 15l when runner up in maiden hurdle at Wexford in May; hung badly left when pulled up on handicap debut at Sligo; solid third off this mark at Bellewstown latest; chance if building on that.
runners.comment: Solid third off this mark at Bellewstown on latest, chance if building on that

runners.name: Illtakehimmyself
runners.spotlight: Has improved for better ground; edging up the weights after placed efforts at Punchestown (3m, gd-yld), Listowel (20.5f, gd-yld) and on latest at Limerick (22.5f, good); nudged up another 2lb, but should be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Has improved for better ground, not far away last three starts, on the premises again

runners.name: Cornaroya Rocco
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but did show some promise in two of his maidens; pulled up on handicap bow at Ballinrobe (2m, good) on latest, however, and needs to leave that behind upped in trip.
runners.comment: Promise in maidens, pulled up on h'cap debut latest, must improve for longer trip

runners.name: Max Time
runners.spotlight: Won off 8lb higher at Galway in September 2024 but has shown virtually nothing since; tailed off at Sligo on latest and impossible to fancy on recent form.
runners.comment: Has lost way since Galway win in 2024, impossible to fancy on recent form

runners.name: Hickeys Hill
runners.spotlight: Point winner off the mark under rules at Fairyhouse in October off 6lb lower (2m, yielding); held off revised mark twice since, though may have needed latest; step up in trip needs to unlock further improvement.
runners.comment: Won off 6lb lower at Fairyhouse in Oct', held off revised mark since, moves up in trip

runners.name: Glaoinn An Airgead
runners.spotlight: Maiden pointer; 0-15 over hurdles and has yet to display winning potential; soundly beaten again at Kilbeggan on return from break latest; others preferred.
runners.comment: 0-15 over hurdles and yet to show winning potential, others appeal more

runners.name: Youknowme
runners.spotlight: 0-7 and yet to trouble the judge; a bit better at Kilbeggan on latest (24.5f, good), but much more needed dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: 0-7, yet to trouble judge, a bit better latest but more needed dropped back in distance

runners.name: Diamond Secret
runners.spotlight: Arguably best effort yet on handicap debut at Kilbeggan (15.5f, gd-yld) when keeping on from the back for a 9l fifth of 13; bred to appreciate this longer trip; could go well.
runners.comment: Kept on well over shorter on h'cap bow latest, step up in trip should suit, could go well

runners.name: Jekiki
runners.spotlight: Long-standing maiden ran okay at Listowel last September, but was still beaten 11.5l into third; mid-field over 2m7f here when last seen in October; may need this on return.
runners.comment: Long standing maiden, off since moderate run here in October, may need this run

runners.name: Penny Jar
runners.spotlight: Conditions are fine for this veteran; has gone well here before and he's well handicapped but hasn't won since October 2024 and his recent efforts have been well below par; revival needed.
runners.comment: No win since 2024, well handicapped, has gone well here before but needs to revive

runners.name: I Feel Fine
runners.spotlight: Best effort yet on return from 131 days off at Kilbeggan (17.5f, gd-yld) when a 7.75l fourth of 13; should strip fitter now, eased 1lb and pedigree suggests that this trip might suit; not discounted.
runners.comment: Strip fitter for improved effort latest, eased 1lb, this trip could suit, not dismissed

runners.name: Ancient Myth
runners.spotlight: Flat winner on fast ground for David O'Meara; huge odds and well held in three maiden hurdles for this yard at 2m-2m1f; potential improver stepped up in trip for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Flat winner for former yard, modest maiden hurdle form, potential improver in first h'cap

runners.name: Lord De Choisel
runners.spotlight: Struggled in all three maiden hurdles on soft and soft to heavy ground; given a break since soundly beaten at Clonmel and tongue tie goes on for handicap debut; best watched unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: Struggled in soft ground maidens, tongue tie on for handicap debut, watch unless backed

races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Pleasureofpressure
runners.spotlight: Consistent and holding form well enough in handicaps; beaten around 6l off this mark the last twice, at Down Royal (2m4f, good) and Wexford (2m1f, gd-yld) when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained); step back up to this trip should suit; in the mix again.
runners.comment: Consistent, beaten similar distances the last twice, step back up in trip a plus, chance

runners.name: Mother Ship
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden over hurdles; her Sligo third from last July off 3lb higher would give her a squeak, but well below that level in two runs since returning from a break, the latest over fences; more needed.
runners.comment: Sligo third last July would give a squeak, two poor runs since back from break, needs more

runners.name: Miss Donna
runners.spotlight: Maiden seemed to appreciate the step up to 22.5f (good) at Clonmel last time when keeping on for a 9.25l third; eased 1lb, but not sure whether the drop back in trip here will suit.
runners.comment: Better effort upped to 22.5f latest, eased 1lb, not sure this drop back in trip will suit

runners.name: Inchidaly Copper
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season included one here over 2m7f (yielding) off 4lb lower; has also won a chase here and is 2-3 at this venue; should be sharper for latest run after break over an inadequate trip, but probably not much wriggle room off this mark.
runners.comment: 2-3 at this venue, sharper for latest run, probably not much in hand off current mark

runners.name: Gaoithe Glory
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles; best efforts have come on soft and soft to heavy ground; beaten 15l on soft at Limerick on latest and only 1lb lower here; more needed.
runners.comment: 0-9 over timber, best form on soft ground, beaten 15l at Limerick latest, more needed

runners.name: Brianna Lily
runners.spotlight: 1-24 over hurdles, the win coming over 3m on heavy ground at Clonmel in 2023; is now 12lb lower, but has disappointed the last twice after showing a bit more at Clonmel in May.
runners.comment: No win since 2023, decent run at Clonmel in May but disappointed the last twice

runners.name: Tedworth
runners.spotlight: Off the mark off 6lb lower in Tramore handicap hurdle in April (20.5f, yielding); came up short off revised rating at Clonmel; was feeling the pinch when unseating two out at Tramore latest; place shout.
runners.comment: Won off 6lb lower at Tramore, 4th off revised mark Clonmel, unseated latest, place chance

runners.name: Swelltime
runners.spotlight: Four wins over hurdles, the most recent coming in this race last year off 2lb lower on yielding to soft, his second win over C&D; out of depth on the Flat last time, but this is more suitable and acts on good ground; player.
runners.comment: Two C&D wins including this last year off 2lb lower, out of depth on Flat latest, player

runners.name: Boston Queen
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens and well beaten on handicap debut here over 2m1f last October (2m1f, yielding); brought down two out when near the rear at Downpatrick on return from break; a bit to prove.
runners.comment: No show in maidens or in first two handicaps, a bit to prove now

runners.name: Koeur A Prendre
runners.spotlight: Left modest maiden form behind to run a fine race when 1.75l second on handicap debut at Clonmel (19.5f, gd-yld); stayed on well from the back that day so whether this sharper track will suit is up for debate, but unexposed and enters calculations.
runners.comment: Stayed on well for second on h'cap debut at Clonmel, unexposed, enters calculations

runners.name: Luck Between Us
runners.spotlight: Solid placed maiden form on good ground last season; struggled in testing conditions the last twice, including on handicap debut at Cork in December; returns from a break now with ground to suit, so check the market.
runners.comment: Solid maiden form on good ground, back from break with ground to suit, check market

runners.name: Malikanna
runners.spotlight: Glimmers of promise in maidens before fine 1l second on handicap debut at Limerick in March (2m, soft); didn't quite see out 2m4f at Wexford on latest (gd-yld); stamina a query again here.
runners.comment: Glimmers in maidens, fine run over 2m on handicap bow, 2m4f seemed too far latest
runners.owner: Eamon Nolan & Mrs Catherine Anne Nolan

runners.name: Ray Gun
runners.spotlight: AW winner on the Flat; 0-5 over hurdles and pulled up in first two handicaps; can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: AW winner on Flat, pulled up in first two handicap hurdles, can only be watched

runners.name: King Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Veteran's five career wins include a handicap chase here in August 2024 (2m5f, yielding); that's the last time he won and pulled up on return from long layoff at Listowel 47 days ago.
runners.comment: Course winner over fences, pulled up on return from long layoff latest

races.race_name: Noel C. Duggan Structural Steel 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Blue Reed
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark in a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in May and a solid run in a Cartmel chase since; 5lb higher than for his win and is up in grade too, but can run well.
runners.comment: Is 5lb higher than for his Kilbeggan win and is up in grade too but can run well

runners.name: Kazakh d'Arthel
runners.spotlight: Won a novice chase at Cork last October, but is a maiden over hurdles; well beaten in this sphere at Ballinrobe last time over 2m, but this trip could suit; is capable of better, so not ruled out.
runners.comment: Well beaten at Ballinrobe over 2m last time but is capable of better so not ruled out

runners.name: Smallcraftwarning
runners.spotlight: Chase winner has won twice over hurdles with last score coming at Clonmel in June 2025; some decent runs this term, but was beaten a long way at Sligo four days ago.
runners.comment: Some decent runs this term but was beaten a long way at Sligo four days ago

runners.name: Tuche De Houelle
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner in France; ran respectably on Irish debut at Limerick after a long absence in a race where the winner was on a faster wide strip of ground; should have improved from that and has a shout.
runners.comment: Ran respectably on Irish debut at Limerick; should have improved from that and has a shout

runners.name: Arcland
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner is only 1-18 over hurdles, but has put up solid runs the last twice at Downpatrick; the blinkers worn last time are retained and can be involved, but needs more to win.
runners.comment: Solid last twice at Downpatrick; the blinkers worn last time are retained; needs more
runners.owner: Exors of the Late E Blaney

runners.name: Only For Our Man
runners.spotlight: Has been in fine form since the spring, winning a 2m6f Down Royal novice handicap before runner-up in Cork and Listowel handicaps over 3m; should be fine dropped in trip and blinkers replace cheekpieces; up 2lb; player.
runners.comment: Has been in fine form since the spring; blinkers replace cheekpieces; up 2lb again; player

runners.name: Market Ready
runners.spotlight: Some decent efforts in defeat in maidens and handicaps in varying ground conditions; beaten favourite in a Clonmel maiden last time; steps up in trip today and a tongue-tie added; needs more but not ruled out.
runners.comment: Maiden steps up in trip today and a tongue-tie added; needs more but not ruled out

runners.name: Global Skies
runners.spotlight: Flat winner has shown much-improved form over hurdles this season, winning at Clonmel and Limerick the last twice over approximately this trip; another 7lb rise demands more, but he has to be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Won at Clonmel and Limerick lately; another 7lb rise demands more but on the shortlist

runners.name: Speakasyoufind
runners.spotlight: Maiden was beaten 5l by today's rival Global Skies at Clonmel last time, his best handicap run; raised 2lb for that and, if he has progressed since, can run respectably again.
runners.comment: Beaten 5l by today's rival Global Skies at Clonmel last time; up 2lb; can run well again

runners.name: Jupiter Du Gite
runners.spotlight: Hurdle and chase winner when trained in the UK; hit and miss, kept to hurdles, since switched to this yard; well beaten when last seen and others appeal more today.
runners.comment: Hit and miss kept to hurdles since switched to this yard and others appeal more today

races.race_name: Kerry Drains Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Kamino Bello
runners.spotlight: Sligo maiden winner last year hasn't matched that form since; was poor at Punchestown, but was better at Downpatrick since; needs a return to his best.
runners.comment: Maiden winner was poor at Punchestown but was better at D'patrick since; needs best

runners.name: Kabylia
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been placed in bumpers and hurdles, but has been poor the last thrice in handicaps and has to do much better.
runners.comment: Maiden has been placed in bumpers and hurdles but has been poor the last thrice

runners.name: Secret Rock
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner in 2023 and also two Flat wins for Tony Martin; won a Kilbeggan handicap on stable debut returning from a 214-day break; needs more up 7lb but a player.
runners.comment: Won a Kilbeggan h'cap on stable debut returning from a 214-day break; needs more up 7lb

runners.name: Katakana
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner in France; won a Thurles handicap hurdle last October, but was poor at Cheltenham next time; market can guide on return with yard in form.
runners.comment: Won a Thurles h'cap last October but poor at Cheltenham next time; market can guide

runners.name: Regards To Rose
runners.spotlight: Won at Listowel last September, but has been well below that level twice this term; needs a return to best; second of three runners for yard.
runners.comment: Won at Listowel last September but well below that level twice this term; needs best
runners.owner: Exors of the Late M Mortell

runners.name: Corkbeg
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won since May 2023, but some solid runs last year; however, is best watched on return unless strong in the market.
runners.comment: Hasn't won since May 2023 and is best watched on return unless strong in the market

runners.name: Party President
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps last year for Tony Mullins, but lost his form after; hit and miss chasing lately for this yard, but would have a chance if back to his best.
runners.comment: Won back-to-back h'caps last year but lost his form after; hit and miss chasing lately

runners.name: Kingdom Calling
runners.spotlight: Winless, but some good runs, since taking a Listowel maiden hurdle in 2024; well beaten chasing last twice, but can't be ruled out back in this discipline with an in-form rider aboard; third runner for yard; watch market.
runners.comment: Winless but some good runs since taking a Listowel maiden in 2024; chasing last twice

runners.name: Home By The Sea
runners.spotlight: Promise in a bumper, but well beaten on first two hurdle starts; much-improved when fourth in a Roscommon maiden last time; has a shout if building on that.
runners.comment: Much-improved when 4th in a Roscommon maiden last time; has a shout if building on that

runners.name: Midnight Eagle
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-18 over hurdles; third in a Clonmel claimer in May, but was beaten a long way on debut for this yard at Downpatrcik since; has to rebound.
runners.comment: Third in a Clonmel claimer in May but was beaten a long way on debut for this yard since

runners.name: Kilt
runners.spotlight: Flat winner won a 2m1f Wexford handicap and a solid run off this mark there since; needs more up in grade, but shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Won a Wexford handicap and a solid run off this mark there since; needs more up in grade

runners.name: Claude
runners.spotlight: Wexford maiden hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien last year; however, has been below that form in four runs for this yard; blinkers replace previously-worn cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien last year; below form in four runs for this yard

runners.name: Mc Swagger
runners.spotlight: Promise in first two bumpers; soundly beaten in maiden hurdles, but can do better in this sphere; one of three for a yard that does well here, so watch the market.
runners.comment: Promise in bumpers; soundly beaten in maiden hurdles but can do better in this sphere

runners.name: Rattledelatch
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper and three hurdles, so has to improve loads on handicap bow off what looks a stiff mark.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a bumper and three hurdles so has to improve loads on h'cap bow
runners.owner: John Joseph Flynn & Conor Lannen & Mrs Miriam Queally

runners.name: Lips Freedom
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat sort on the continent got off the mark over hurdles last time at Downpatrick; got an 11lb hike for that, but goes well fresh and is still rated 90 on the Flat, so has to be respected.
runners.comment: Useful Flat sort got off the mark over hurdles last time; 11lb hike but goes well fresh

races.race_name: Matchbook Exchange INH Flat Race

runners.name: Caislean Gear
runners.spotlight: Solid debut effort at Roscommon on yielding to soft ground, but didn't improve from that at Limerick since, albeit still a decent effort; sets the standard on form, but vulnerable to a decent newcomer.
runners.comment: Two solid runs; sets the standard on form but is still vulnerable to a decent newcomer

runners.name: Inishtearaght
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-brother to AW bumper and useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Golden Taipan; dam unraced and from the family of high-class chaser The Grey Monk; by a promising young sire and cost E22,000 as a 3yo; tongue-tie on for debut; top rider booked and one to be interested in, especially if there is market strength.
runners.comment: Top rider booked and one to be interested in for debut especially if market strength

runners.name: Bairdin
runners.spotlight: One of two runners for yard; second foal; dam placed 2m2f-3m1f hurdles, sister to winner Montys Meadow (useful bumper/2m hurdle/2m4f chase) and family of Grand National winner Monty's Pass; decent pedigree but a E5,000 vendor buyback as a foal; worth a market check; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: A E5,000 vendor buyback as a foal; worth a market check; tongue-tie

runners.name: Bravemans Call
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam point winner, half-sister to 2m3f-3m3f hurdle winner Bryden Boy and bumper winner Hideaway Vic, out of bumper/2m4f hurdle winner; E10,000 foal is by a quality French sire and his yard does well at this track, so worth a market check.
runners.comment: By a quality French sire and his yard does well at this track so worth a market check

runners.name: Emergency Man
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to point winner Diamond Jetaway; dam placed 2m3f-3m hurdles, sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Jet Master, from family of high-class chaser Blazing Walker; unsold for E4,800 as a 3yo; yard can ready a newcomer, so needs a market check.
runners.comment: Unsold for E4,800 as a 3yo; yard can ready a newcomer so needs a market check

runners.name: Throwmedownsomthin
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam 1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 82), sister to 1m4f-2m winner Pantomime, half-sister to 7f/1m winner Darkening, out of 6f winner; Flat-bred but there is stamina in his damline; could run respectably on debut.
runners.comment: Flat-bred but there is stamina in his damline; could run respectably on debut

runners.name: Walkineezy
runners.spotlight: Second foal; brother to point winner Fox Walk; dam 1m7f hurdle winner, out of 2m hurdle-winning half-sister to Grand National winner Rule The World; by the champion sire but cost only E16,000 as a 3yo; top rider booked and one to check for market strength.
runners.comment: By the Champion sire and a top rider booked so one to check for market strength
runners.owner: Exors of the Late Michael Moloney

runners.name: Charles Kickham
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; raced too keenly when beaten 28l in a Down Royal bumper in May; will need to settle better and a hood may help.
runners.comment: Beaten 28l in a Down Royal bumper in May; will need to settle better and a hood may help

races.race_name: Kate Kearney's Cottage (Ladies Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Flashy Fred
runners.spotlight: Beaten 9l on sole point start by a rival that made E100,000 since; ran a cracker on bumper debut at Downpatrick when runner-up to a more experienced rival; can improve for that and a leading lady rider aboard, so a solid chance.
runners.comment: Runner-up to a more experienced rival; leading lady rider aboard so a solid chance

runners.name: Well Bud
runners.spotlight: Not a lot of promise when failing to complete in two point starts; however, a different story over C&D on bumper debut when beaten only 11l; the tongue-tie worn then is retained and should have improved since, so is a player.
runners.comment: Beaten 11l over C&D on bumper debut and should have improved since so is a player

runners.name: No Brainer
runners.spotlight: By a useful sire and from the family of Gold Cup winner Long Run; however, has been pulled-up on both point runs, so isn't easy to fancy; tongue-tie on.
runners.comment: Has been pulled-up on both point runs so isn't easy to fancy; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Village Dream
runners.spotlight: Sister to 2m5f-3m2f chase winner Village Master, half-sister to four winners including Bun Doran (high-class bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and Shantou Village (smart bumper and 2m4f-2m7f hurdle/chase); a sibling to some smart sorts, but seems the champion trainer's second-string; could still run well; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Sibling to some smart sorts but seems the champion trainer's second-string;  tongue-tie

runners.name: Eleen Alana
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners Thou Art Peter (1m/1m2f inc HK dirt; RPR 80) and Bungle Inthedesert (1m AW; 73); dam unraced half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Saab Alamanal; Flat-bred filly was a E5,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; stamina concerns, so best watched for future reference.
runners.comment: Flat-bred filly was a E5,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; stamina concerns; best watched

runners.name: Whitehall Girl
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners Slainte Mhor (3m chase) and Persian Daughter (2m6f hurdle); dam unraced half-sister to high-class 2m5f-3m6f hurdle/chase winner Ad Hoc; by a useful sire and a decent damline; cost E4,000 as a 3yo; will likely improve from this.
runners.comment: Decent pedigree; cost E4,000 as a 3yo; will likely improve from this

runners.name: Without Deception
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam runner-up in 1m3f/1m4f AQPS Flat races and 2m4f hurdle, half-sister to high-class bumper and 2m-2m7f/chase hurdle winner Bacardys; E25,000 foal then made only E16,000 as a 3yo; decent pedigree; tongue-tie for debut; best watched unless market support.
runners.comment: E25,000 foal made only E16,000 as a 3yo; tongue-tie for debut; likely best watched

runners.name: All Of A Sudden
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; dam placed 2m4f/2m6f hurdles, half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Marvada (dam of 1m2f Group 2 winner Terebellum), out of French 1m3f winner; dam hasn't a great record at stud; unsold for E1,800 as a 3yo; doesn't make a lot of appeal on debut.
runners.comment: Unsold for E1,800 as a 3yo; doesn't make a lot of appeal on debut

runners.name: Amazing Times
runners.spotlight: Beaten 18l on sole completed point start and doesn't make much appeal on bumper debut.
runners.comment: Beaten 18l on sole completed point start and doesn't make much appeal on bumper debut

runners.name: Langage du Large
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to five winners including the useful Farceur Du Large; started 5/2 favourite and was running respectably on point debut when falling last year; likely best watched unless strong in the market.
runners.comment: Was running respectably on point debut when falling last year; likely best watched

runners.name: You Lift Me Up
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to bumper winner Wilton Mills Trier; dam unraced half-sister to winners Solsbury Hill (2m hurdle/chase) and Reelingintheyears (2m3f hurdle); E5,000 foal was unsold for E4,500 as a 3yo; not a bad pedigree and could be capable of running well.
runners.comment: Unsold for E4,500 as a 3yo; not a bad pedigree and could be capable of running well

runners.name: Adifferentballowax
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in the Goffs Defender bumper on debut and not much better in a Limerick maiden hurdle; best watched for the time being.
runners.comment: Well beaten in a bumper and maiden hurdle so best watched for the time being
runners.owner: John F Doyle & R Bannerman & Mrs Sheila O'Ryan

runners.name: Super Freak
runners.spotlight: Respectable debut effort for former yard when beaten 16l in a Galway bumper nearly a year ago; absence since is a concern, but could run well for a respected local yard.
runners.comment: Beaten 16l in a Galway bumper nearly a year ago; could run well for a respected local yard

runners.name: Farney Bridge
runners.spotlight: Beaten 23l on debut at Punchestown and will have to improve plenty on that to score.
runners.comment: Beaten 23l on debut at Punchestown and will have to improve plenty on that to score

runners.name: S T Hamo
runners.spotlight: Beaten 17l and 23l in two bumpers on varying ground conditions; fitted with a hood and tongue-tie today, but best watched for the time being.
runners.comment: Beaten 17l and 23l in two bumpers; hood on today but best watched for the time being

runners.name: Cast A Cold Eye
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Champion Bumper winner Bambino Fever; was weak in the market when beaten 13l on debut at Ballinrobe last September; likely to do better after an absence and is one for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Beaten 13l on debut at Ballinrobe last September; likely to do better after an absence

races.race_name: Betfred "The Classic Bookmaker" EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Zarakova
runners.spotlight: 190,000gns yearling by Zarak; first foal of Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (RPR 99), herself out of 1m Group 1 winner; 9-2 from 7-1 for novice at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) seven weeks ago, led early and went okay turning for home, but she was last of six from over 1f out; needs to leave that way behind.
runners.comment: 190,000gns yearling; 9-2 from 7-1, last of six at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) seven weeks ago

runners.name: Palace Legacy
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; Palace Pier half-brother to four winners including Great David (Listed-placed 1m 2yo/1m2f; RPR 105), Kinderfrau (1m5f/2m; 87) and Leadership (UAE 7f/1m; 84); dam Group-placed 1m-10.4f winner (107) out of 12.5f Group 2 winner; trainer's 2yos have 25% strike-rate (6-24) this term.
runners.comment: Palace Pier half-brother to four winners, notably Great David (1m 2yo/1m2f; RPR 105)

runners.name: Ad Lib
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Kingman half-brother to winners San Juanito (8.6f/9.4f; RPR 89) and Proposal (7f; 77); dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Group 3 winner (116) out of 7f-1m4f winner; newcomer to note from strong yard.
runners.comment: Half-brother to winners San Juanito (8.6f/9.4f; RPR 89) and Proposal (7f; 77); dam smart

runners.name: Jaipur Prince
runners.spotlight: 48,000gns yearling by Kodi Bear; first foal; dam 5f winner (RPR 68) out of 6f 2yo Group 3 winning half-sister to 7f Group 1 winner Toylsome; others are a bit more striking on paper.
runners.comment: 48,000gns yearling by Kodi Bear; dam 5f winner (RPR 68) out of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner

runners.name: The Balearic Sun
runners.spotlight: 300,000gns yearling by Lope De Vega; half-brother to four winners, mostly useful or smart, notably Berkshire Rocco (7f-2m including 2yo/Listed; RPR 117); 5-1 for novice at Sandown (7f, good) 13 days ago but slowly into stride and, having raced in mid-division, readily outpaced from 3f out; that 15l defeat was a downbeat start and he now has his tongue tied.
runners.comment: 300,000gns yearling by Lope De Vega; 15l defeat at Sandown (7f, good); now has tongue tied

races.race_name: Steve Donoghue Handicap

runners.name: Eutropia
runners.spotlight: Three wins this year, the last two at Bath (1m/1m2f) in April and she's continued to look in good form, beaten a head at Salisbury (1m) on latest start; firmly in the mix if she adapts to this track.
runners.comment: Won twice at Bath (1m/1m2f) in April and she's continued to look in good form

runners.name: Penfolds Grange
runners.spotlight: The only impact he made in three turf races (last April-July) came when third on good ground at Chester, which is up with his best AW form; pretty reliable with his minor AW honours this year, so needs considering.
runners.comment: 3rd on good at Chester last year; pretty reliable on AW this year, so needs considering

runners.name: Bobacious
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; latest win was under Mason Paetel here (1m2f) early last July for Ed Dunlop; 4lb lower today but that's after he went off the boil and there's been only a partial revival for new yard this year, finishing sixth of nine here last time in the race he won last year; the last time he raced over a trip this short was May 2025.
runners.comment: Front-runner; latest win was 1m2f here last July; only a partial revival this year

runners.name: Trio
runners.spotlight: 3yo who's had respectable efforts in her first four handicaps, before a lesser show from wide draw at Kempton latest; place chance if back to her best.
runners.comment: Lesser show from wide draw at Kempton on latest outing; place chance if back to her best
runners.owner: M H Dixon & J L Rowsell

runners.name: Letsbeatsepsis
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden who's in his third season; runner-up over 1m2f in one of his two visits here last summer and two minor honours (7.6f/1m) from three starts this term; cheekpieces (tried once as 3yo, well held) return but he does not look the percentage call for win purposes.
runners.comment: 15-race maiden; further minor honours are possible, but not the percentage call win-wise

runners.name: Kitaro Kich
runners.spotlight: 5-21 on AW compared to 0-10 on turf and he's been well beaten in his two races here; turf mark is 12lb below AW figure and he should have come on since his recent, creditable reappearance, but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: 5-21 on AW compared to 0-10 on turf and he's been well beaten in his two races here
runners.owner: J Machale, S Tucker & S Jewell

runners.name: Bennyworth
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden and his best show in five handicaps was on first occasion (1m, AW); 8lb lower today but lacks any pressing claims.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden and his best show in five handicaps was on first occasion (1m, AW)

runners.name: Hurricane Laughter
runners.spotlight: Marked improvement is needed but he's had just four races; fifth of ten on seasonal/handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good) four weeks ago failed to match his market position but he staged something of a rally, after hanging left over 2f out, and might build on that.
runners.comment: Fifth of ten on seasonal/handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good) and might build on that

runners.name: Boston Run
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; latest of his three seconds was in April 2025 and he's not made a serious impact since; off since January and hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Latest of his three seconds was in April 2025 and he's not made a serious impact since

races.race_name: Chantilly Handicap

runners.name: Hello Cotai
runners.spotlight: Spent last year in France; fine record here, including two wins in summer 2024 and a third off this mark in a blanket finish two weeks ago; the latter followed a Windsor win (1m2f, win); looks set for another big run.
runners.comment: Fine record here includes two wins, plus third off this mark in a blanket finish last time

runners.name: Booziebrunch
runners.spotlight: Reliable 3yo whose two wins (from 13 races) were in very small fields, latterly when making all at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago; that was a runaway win and the first time he's made the running, but he's 5lb higher today in what looks a more competitive race.
runners.comment: Reliable 3yo whose two wins were in very small fields; made all at Newmarket (1m2f) latest

runners.name: Show Biz Kid
runners.spotlight: Held up; ran creditably sole start here (2024); latest of his two wins came when dropped into Class 6 at Bath (1m2f, firm) in May, before a Class 4 at Yarmouth saw a lesser effort; should be competitive in this race.
runners.comment: Won Class 6 at Bath (1m2f, firm) in May, before a Class 4 at Yarmouth saw a lesser effort

runners.name: Perfect Scoundrel
runners.spotlight: Best efforts from his five handicaps were on last two starts when third at Goodwood (1m1f, good to soft) and beaten a head at Newbury (1m2f, good to firm); back up 2lb but his first win should not be far away.
runners.comment: Last two starts when third at Goodwood (1m1f) and beaten a head at Newbury (1m2f)
runners.owner: Mrs F Cotton, Mr & Mrs P Conway

races.race_name: Betfred Ladies' Derby Handicap (For Female Amateur Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Shahbaz
runners.spotlight: Creditable third off 9lb higher over C&D on soft ground (acts on good to firm) last September in his only Epsom race; AW campaign in the winter for new yard did not go at all well until he perked up a bit in February on his last two outings; needs to build on that after his break but he's too well handicapped to be ignored.
runners.comment: Needs to build on February form after his break, but too well handicapped to be ignored

runners.name: Damascus Steel
runners.spotlight: Did well on AW last winter and even better form when the cheekpieces replaced a visor at Goodwood (1m4f, good) four weeks ago, leading over 1f out to score with rather more authority than the half-length winning margin suggests; used to act on good to firm; up 3lb but firmly in the picture.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces replaced a visor when he won at Goodwood (1m4f, good) four weeks ago; up 3lb

runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: 1m2f Listed winner here in 2023 but well beaten on his only visit since; no win since a Group 3 in August 2023 but placed in AW/turf handicaps (1m-1m4f) this spring and continues down the weights; needs much better than he produced on last two outings.
runners.comment: Placed in handicaps this spring but needs much better than he produced on last two outings

runners.name: I'd Go Maniac
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 1m4f AW handicap winner; only three runs on Flat turf, the latest when second of 13 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May in first-time cheekpieces, which have been kept since; not disgraced when Georgia King was on again back on AW latest outing; needs a second look.
runners.comment: 1m4f AW win; only three runs on Flat turf, second at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May

runners.name: Carnival Day
runners.spotlight: All wins have been at 1m2f and he ran well over the extended 1m here on reappearance, before a lesser show at Sandown; his record at this track is very solid, but those on good to firm and at 1m4f less so.
runners.comment: His record at this track is very solid, but those on good to firm and at 1m4f less so

runners.name: Naval Command
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden whose easily best display in three handicaps came when fifth of ten at Chester (1m2f) in June; the lesser shows on either side were over about 1m3f; blinkers (worn on last two starts) are removed; 7lb lower than on handicap/seasonal debut but something to prove.
runners.comment: Six-race maiden; 7lb lower than on handicap/seasonal debut but something to prove

runners.name: Pride Of Nepal
runners.spotlight: 8yo who went 21 months without a win but has now scored at Windsor, Lingfield, Chepstow and Ripon in his four races this turf season; his second in this race last year was a remote one and the 6lb rise since his latest start asks a question, but conditions fine and he's on a major roll, ridden by Sarah Bowen on last two starts (two in four days); major player.
runners.comment: 21 months without a win but has now scored in all his four races this turf season

races.race_name: Vail Williams Handicap

runners.name: Uppercase
runners.spotlight: Can make the running and he went on before halfway when gamely winning a six-runnner handicap at Catterick (7f, good to soft) five weeks ago, getting off the mark at eighth attempt; back up 2lb and unraced on good to firm, with this track a new experience too, but that latest run gives him a shot.
runners.comment: Can make the running; off the mark at Catterick (7f, good to soft) five weeks ago

runners.name: Musical Angel
runners.spotlight: Made all last term in a maiden at Brighton (good to firm) and a handicap over C&D (good to soft), the latter in September on final run for Andrew Balding; back over C&D on last two outings and not disgraced when sixth of ten on latest (co-favourite); case can be made back on last winning mark.
runners.comment: Twice made all (once C&D) for A Balding last term; not disgraced latest run for new yard

runners.name: Atmosphere
runners.spotlight: Reliable sort (on turf and AW) who won twice last summer and was runner-up in March/April on his last two outings; stable has struck often enough this summer for him to be given a close look despite this new track.
runners.comment: Reliable sort (on turf and AW) who was runner-up in March/April on his last two outings

runners.name: Cherry Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Won at Newmarket (7f, good) in May, ran respectably at Goodwood next time and beaten a neck at Newmarket four weeks ago; finished last in April (reappearance) in his only race on good to firm but otherwise needs plenty of respect.
runners.comment: Last in April (reappearance) in his only race on good to firm; plenty of respect otherwise

runners.name: Dream Of Mischief
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in 2024 but three subsequent visits have not gone nearly so well; none too consistent but two of his last four AW runs, including in January latest, give him a shout if he's ready following the absence; he's twice been runner-up after longer layoffs.
runners.comment: C&D winner; two of his last four AW runs, including in January latest, give him a shout

races.race_name: Betfred Everswift 30 July Handicap

runners.name: Ice Cube
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who made the running on first three starts this term but switched to trying to come from the rear when hooded on both since; Newmarket latest (7f, good to firm; 40-1) was a positive performance as he seemed to be gathering momentum in the closing stages and was beaten just 2l in sixth of 11; dropped 2lb today and everything may well click into place soon.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden but Newmarket latest (7f, good to firm; 40-1) was a positive performance

runners.name: Piazza
runners.spotlight: Unraced on good to firm except on debut (last of four); yard is among the winners and a recent, never-nearer fifth of 12 on the Kempton AW (7f; 12-1) was a respectable start to this filly's 3yo campaign, not getting the clearest of runs late on; needs a close look.
runners.comment: Yard is among the winners; recent Kempton AW run (7f; 12-1) was a respectable reappearance

runners.name: Madman
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 17 races was on Kempton AW (6f) in January; new yard when back on turf for last three outings, not far away in two of those but better is needed to win this; his only two attempts over this far did not convince.
runners.comment: Sole win (17 races) was on AW in January; his only two runs over this far did not convince

runners.name: Credit Forgedd It
runners.spotlight: Best effort in eight starts for Richard Hannon when beaten a neck in a Wolverhampton nursery (8.6f, AW) in December; 6,000gns buy in February before never dangerous in a small field at Brighton (7f, good to firm; 28-1) 16 days ago; needs a rapid revival.
runners.comment: 6,000gns buy in February; never dangerous in a small field at Brighton (28-1) 16 days ago

runners.name: Eyes Front
runners.spotlight: Probably started handicap life on a demanding mark and he'd dropped 10lb before going down by just under 2l when fifth of 15 at Doncaster (7f, good) in first-time blinkers on latest outing; hit the front over 1f out that day but wandered under pressure; needs to see it out better.
runners.comment: Hit the front at Doncaster (7f, good) in first-time blinkers but wandered and four went by

runners.name: Twilight Glow
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; reappearance was his best show this term and, having had four starts since, it's hard to get excited about his chance today despite the falling mark; first wore a visor on latest outing.
runners.comment: Nine-race maiden; reappearance was his best show this term, with four starts since

runners.name: Sun Of Dolly
runners.spotlight: Best form when fourth of 13 on handicap debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm), faring best of those held up; readily outgunned once in the clear at Haydock (upped to 7f) later in May but soft ground was a possible excuse.
runners.comment: 4th on handicap debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm); soft ground a possible excuse latest

runners.name: Karisma's Angel
runners.spotlight: Debut (well beaten) was her only start on turf; sent handicapping for last two outings and came second of eight at Wolverhampton (7f) in February on latest, albeit beaten 13l; relatively early days but it's not yet clear that she's worth this mark.
runners.comment: 13l second in February latest; early days but not yet clear that she's worth this mark

races.race_name: CopyBet Bog Today For Tomorrow's Racing Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners.spotlight: Has left his hurdle form behind over fences and he beat the odds-on winner with the pair clear at Stratford last weekend (2m3f, good to firm); carries a penalty for that in what looks a winnable contest.
runners.comment: Successful last weekend and carries a penalty for that in what looks a winnable contest

runners.name: Atlanta Brave
runners.spotlight: Struggles for consistency and has gone backwards since finishing third at Hereford in March (3m1f, good); first-time blinkers did nothing for him last time and they're retained.
runners.comment: Inconsistent and has gone backwards since finishing third at Hereford in March

runners.name: Thank You Blue
runners.spotlight: Multiple hurdle winner who is rated 12lb lower over fences and he rediscovered some form when beaten 2l at Cartmel three weeks ago (2m5f, good); should be bang there if repeating that effort.
runners.comment: Should be well treated over fences and only beaten 2l last time at Cartmel

runners.name: Atreides
runners.spotlight: Won twice over fences within a week last December but has essentially struggled off his new mark and still 6lb higher than for those two wins; still commands some respect in this weak a race.
runners.comment: Looks on a tough mark but still commands some respect in this weak a race

runners.name: Suttons Hill
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-14 in Irish points; 0-9 over hurdles (was placed); made a quiet stable debut in that discipline and he was pulled up in a hunter chase on one previous run over fences.
runners.comment: Underwhelming profile in Ireland; quiet over hurdles on recent stable debut

runners.name: Keep Me Posted
runners.spotlight: Eight defeats under rules include seven as a chaser; forgettable form in Irish points this year.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish gelding; 0-7 as a chaser and forgettable form in Irish points this year

races.race_name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Henry Box Brown
runners.spotlight: Well treated on his old form but his last win was in December 2024 and he's finished down the field in his three completed starts this year; cheekpieces now return but he needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: His last win was in December 2024 and was well held at Bangor latest; headgear back on

runners.name: Carpe Diem
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a Huntingdon handicap (2m4f, soft) in February and he's finished runner-up in four over his five starts since; his latest second was behind Knightsbridge at Warwick but he has big swing in the weights with that rival and should be in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: In-form 8y who chased home Knightsbridge at Warwick last time; in the mix again

runners.name: Huckleberry Sting
runners.spotlight: No win in five starts over hurdles but he made it 2-4 over fences when beating eight rivals at Market Rasen (3m, good) 11 days ago; has a penalty but that was a cosy success and he's open to more progress at staying trips; respected.
runners.comment: Made it 2-4 over fences with a cosy success at Market Rasen; respected under a penalty

runners.name: Knightsbridge
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdler but he's been a big improver since switched to fences, winning over 3m at Warwick last month before following up over about 2m4f here (both on good) two weeks ago; up another 7lb but he won going away last time and is a major player again in his bid to make it 3-4 as a chaser.
runners.comment: Improver who made it 2-3 over fences when scoring here two weeks ago; big player again

runners.name: I'm A Starman
runners.spotlight: Admirable veteran who nearly recorded his ninth hurdle win when a close second here (2m7f, good) in May; 0-8 over fences but he's 12lb lower back in this sphere and he does have some placed form in chase handicaps; dangerous with blinkers reapplied.
runners.comment: Went close over hurdles here latest and he's 12lb lower back over fences; dangerous

runners.name: School For Scandal
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner, most recently at Windsor (3m, good to soft) in the autumn; back on a good mark now but he's not easy to predict and has been pulled up on two of his last three outings (bled from the nose last time); others preferred.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but he's been pulled up in two of his last three outings; down the list
runners.owner: K Johns & Joe Tickle Racing Club

runners.name: Stay Hopeful
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who has yet to show any worthwhile form under rules and was tailed off on chase debut over C&D (good) last month; still lightly raced but cheekpieces hasn't worked in his last three runs and he needs a visor to make a big difference.
runners.comment: Point winner but has yet to show any worthwhile form under rules; visor now tried

runners.name: Elfride
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 25 starts over hurdles and she's generally struggled in that sphere in last seven starts; pulled up in only previous chase run in February 2025 and has lots to prove back in this sphere; 5lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: 1-25 over hurdles and was pulled in only previous chase run; 5lb out of the weights

races.race_name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.name: Mr Rafiki
runners.spotlight: Finished last in his only bumper and beaten between 15l and 36l in three maiden hurdles (2m2f-2m4f); hard to make a compelling case for him but he has shown something and this is weak.
runners.comment: Hard to make a compelling case for him but he has shown something and this is weak

runners.name: Loman Lady
runners.spotlight: Comfortable winner of a weak bumper at Hexham but was a remote sixth back there when long odds-on for her hurdle debut (2m4f); that was probably too bad to be true.
runners.comment: Hexham bumper winner; remote 6th back there on hurdle debut when long odds-on

runners.name: Walkingtheline
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner but has looked very limited under rules; 300-1 when pulled up here 15 days ago; the tongue-tie is new.
runners.comment: Has looked very limited under rules; 300-1 when pulled up here 15 days ago

runners.name: Jorah d'Alma
runners.spotlight: Below best last time but the start before he had run well (looked held) before falling late on at Warwick (2m3f, good); every chance on that form.
runners.comment: Below par last time but was running well when he fell the outing before

runners.name: Witheros Hill
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who was tailed off in an Irish bumper and gone 0-10 in points there; new headgear combination on yard debut.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish mare who was tailed off in an Irish bumper and gone 0-10 in points there

races.race_name: CopyBet Daily Profit Boost Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Square d'Alboni
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat performer who made it third-time lucky over hurdles with a dominant display after wind surgery at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; just about sets the standard under a penalty and he could have a lot more to offer in this sphere; strong contender.
runners.comment: Listed Flat winner who got off the mark over hurdles at Stratford last month; big player

runners.name: Chemistry
runners.spotlight: On his third trainer and has rather chequered form but he won on hurdling debut at Sedgefield (2m1f, good) in May and ran to a similar level when runner-up under a penalty at Kelso later that month; struggled back on the Flat last time but that was in the Northumberland Vase and he's respected back in this sphere; tongue-tie and cheekpieces are added.
runners.comment: Win and second in his two runs over hurdles and he's respected back in this sphere
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Wait At The Gate
runners.spotlight: Point winner in April but he has a modest completion rate in that sphere and was pulled up at Kingston Blount last time; now makes his rules debut and he's probably best watched.
runners.comment: Point winner but has modest completion rate in that sphere; best watched on rules debut

runners.name: Baileys Big Image
runners.spotlight: Beaten out of sight in her sole bumper and same story at massive prices in two hurdle runs this summer.
runners.comment: Beaten out of sight in sole bumper and same story at massive prices in two hurdle runs

runners.name: Scoro
runners.spotlight: Only 1-12 in points and he's been beaten 44l and 43l in two hurdle runs (2m, good) this summer.
runners.comment: Only 1-12 in points and he's been beaten 44l and 43l in two hurdle runs this summer

runners.name: Connemara Joe
runners.spotlight: 0-7 in Irish points and he's been tailed off at big prices in both hurdle runs including behind Square d'Alboni at Stratford two weeks ago.
runners.comment: 0-7 in Irish points and he's been tailed at big prices in two hurdle runs this summer

runners.name: Imperial Trooper
runners.spotlight: Just 1-18 on the Flat but showed fair form when placed twice over 1m2f this spring; should have a future over hurdles but he made a low-key start in this sphere over C&D (good; 20-1) last month; stablemate of Chemistry.
runners.comment: Fair Flat performer but he made a low-key start over hurdles in a C&D maiden last month

runners.name: Lamlash
runners.spotlight: Poor form on the Flat and was pulled up in his only previous run over hurdles; can only be watched back in this sphere.
runners.comment: Poor form on the Flat and was pulled up in his only previous run over hurdles
runners.owner: H Maye And The Joe Tickle Racing Club

races.race_name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Kantagua Du Large
runners.spotlight: Her sole win was over fences in France in January 2024; has dropped a long way in the weights and she's been tailed off in last two runs and is now 0-10 for current yard; opposable.
runners.comment: Has dropped a long way in weights but she's been tailed off in last two runs; opposable

runners.name: Fane Court
runners.spotlight: 0-7 under rules but he's reached the frame in both runs for his current yard including when third in a C&D handicap (good) last week; on same mark here and has each-way claims again.
runners.comment: 0-7 under rules but he was placed in a C&D handicap last week; each-way claims again

runners.name: Ikigai Star
runners.spotlight: Won off 10lb higher at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) last May but he's been disappointing since and was beaten 10l back on the Flat (1m6f) two weeks ago; has lots to prove and this is his first run beyond 2m5f.
runners.comment: On reduced mark but he has plenty to prove at this new trip

runners.name: The Great Escape
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on handicap debut here (2m4f, good) last July but he's struggled since, including in three runs this year; overall record is now 0-10 and he has plenty to prove back up in trip.
runners.comment: Runner-up on handicap debut here (2m4f) last July but he's struggled since; lots to prove

runners.name: Hardy Buck
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in his final run during winter but that was in the mud and he won by 7l over this trip at Exeter (good to soft) in December; looks interesting on that form and he needs a close look back from five months off.
runners.comment: Won at Exeter last winter and he needs a close look back from five months off

runners.name: Final Entry
runners.spotlight: 5yo who made it 2-7 over hurdles when scoring in a first-time visor at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last month; that was by a nose but he hit a personal best with that success and is still unexposed at staying trips; respected up 4lb.
runners.comment: Made it to 2-7 over hurdles with a narrow success at Newton Abbot (3m2f); respected up 4lb

runners.name: Warner's Cross
runners.spotlight: Won at Market Rasen (2m4f, good) in June 2024 but he's not seen much action since and has struggled over hurdles and fences in last five runs; now 14lb lower than for his win but he needs a major revival back in this sphere.
runners.comment: On reduced mark but he needs a major revival back over hurdles

races.race_name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Shesonnet
runners.spotlight: Warwick winner in May (2m5f, good) and kept on to go down by only a length over C&D a month ago; solid chance off 2lb higher.
runners.comment: Warwick winner in May and only a length away over C&D a month ago; solid chance

runners.name: Royal Rhythm
runners.spotlight: The last of his four hurdle wins was in late 2023; well beaten in this discipline before pulling up on last week's belated return to fences.
runners.comment: Well beaten in this discipline before pulling up on last week's belated return to fences

runners.name: Dublinofficecallin
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m4f Perth handicap for Ewan Whillans in April (good) when 4lb lower; tailed off in two subsequent runs, the latest when only 3-1 for yard debut at Stratford (2m; reportedly never travelled); clearly capable of a big run but risky at the minute.
runners.comment: 2m4f handicap winner for previous yard; never travelled at all on his debut for this one

runners.name: Locked Down Lad
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer; 0-14 over hurdles but has placed form and interesting that he was sent off the 7-2 favourite when pretty much tailed off here 15 days ago (after three months off); hard to trust on the back of that effort, for all that better was presumably expected.
runners.comment: Hard to trust on the back of latest effort, for all that better was presumably expected

runners.name: Golden Glance
runners.spotlight: Exploited much-reduced mark at Southwell (2m4f, good) and it was over 2m7f when not so good at Bangor; this should be more her trip but she is a hard mare to predict.
runners.comment: 2m4f winner before failing to fire over 2m7f; however, she is a hard mare to predict

runners.name: Phantom Gold
runners.spotlight: Useful bumper winner for Ben Brookhouse; still lightly raced and runner-up in both his handicaps, only narrowly failing to justify market support last time here over 2m; only 3lb higher and should stay this far; has been held up in recent races.
runners.comment: Second in both his handicaps, only short-headed last time; should stay this far

runners.name: Leave Her To Me
runners.spotlight: Out of form in two runs last winter but she is 3-12 over hurdles and realistically handicapped if she can rediscover her form; market could be helpful back from a break.
runners.comment: Out of form in two runs last winter but she is 3-12 over hurdles and realistically treated

runners.name: Prince Imperial
runners.spotlight: Won four of his first five for Olly Murphy (including a handicap off much higher mark) but he's lost his way badly.
runners.comment: Capable hurdler for Olly Murphy but he's lost his way badly

races.race_name: Prix Pelleas (Listed Race) (Colts & Geldings) (Turf)

runners.name: Gentlemanlike
runners.owner: Alain Jathiere, Ecurie David R Layani Famille Et Al

races.race_name: CRE Run Farm Handicap Stakes 0-60

runners.name: Ghayah (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Having a third quick run with cheekpieces replacing a visor; should find this company a bit easier than her first two runs and with a positive jockey booking is likely to go close. (R2 W0 P2) (OR 59)

runners.name: Sassy (Gb)
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season and has now returned to her last winning mark; back down to a more suitable grade, at a track she likes better can be expected this time. (R17 W3 P7) (OR 54)

runners.name: Victoria (Gb)
runners.spotlight: No match for runaway winner at Lingfield last week but finished a long way clear of the rest.; conditions here are fine for her and she's capable of winning of this mark; solid claims. (R21 W2 P12) (OR 55)

runners.name: Zayin Sentinel (Gb)
runners.spotlight: Has looked a work in progress on both starts to date; this looks his easiest task to date as cheekpieces go on for the first time and improvement is likely at some stage.  (R2 W0 P0) (OR 60)

runners.name: Zizania Du Mazet (Fr)
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really kicked on after her winning here final start as a juvenile; her latest run in Listed company was a step back in the right direction and has to be respected if in the same form. (R11 W1 P7) (OR 52)

runners.name: Aloof (GB)
runners.spotlight: Course winner who can often be slowly away; when in the mood she usually finishes strongly and she stays well; didn't show much on her seasonal debut but might improve for the run; small each way claims in a very open heat. (R23 W3 P5) (OR 37)

runners.name: Shakura Sky Zayin (Gb)
runners.spotlight: Unplaced twice last season and return here off a mark where improvement is likely; from a late maturing family and should do better this season, market moves should be noted. (R2 W0 P0) (OR 52)

runners.name: Abu Shomran (Gb)
runners.spotlight: Looked in need of the experience on both starts to date; makes her seasonal and handicap debut off a workable mark and is open to lots of improvement for the Champion Trainer; the market will reveal more. (R2 W0 P0) (OR 52)
